🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Amended Delimitation Bill likely to be tabled in special Parliament sitting from November 30

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 01:34:56 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Centre announces special sitting of Parliament from November 30, 2026, over 100 days since both Houses were adjourned without prorogation; government trying to pass the Bill after ‘operation lotus’, says Congress

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The government has called for a special sitting of Parliament beginning Monday (November 30, 2026), where it is likely to table an amended Delimitation Bill. The two Houses will meet on separate dates, Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju announced on Thursday (November 26, 2026), which is the 104th day since the Monsoon Session adjourned indefinitely on August 13. Lok Sabha sittings will begin on November 30 and Rajya Sabha sittings on December 2. Both Houses will conclude on December 3. The last record of a session of Parliament continuing unprorogued was in 2008 , when it went on for 87 days. The Union Cabinet will meet on Friday (November 27, 2026) to clear the amended legislation. According to sources, three crucial changes are being introduced: a uniform 50% increase in the share of Lok Sabha seats; extending the freeze for 25 years on using the 1971 Census as the basis to determine the proportional strength of each State in the Lok Sabha; and third, using the 2011 Census for redrawing constituencies within each State. This replicates the formula brought by the Atal Bihari Vajpayee government in the Constitution (Eighty-fourth Amendment) Act, 2001. Reacting to the announcement, Congress general secretary (communication) Jairam Ramesh said the Narendra Modi government announced the session “after 105 days of operation lotus” in the hope of getting a “super-tainted” two-thirds majority to get the Bill passed. “Can there be a great insult to and assault on the Constitution,” he asked in a post on X, noting that the announcement came on Constitution Day. Congress general secretary (organisation) K.C. Venugopal took to X to describe the attempt to pass the Delimitation Bill as “ sansad chori” . “To orchestrate this murder of the Constitution on Constitution Day shows how badly they want to mock our precious democratic system. We will not allow this to pass,” Mr. Venugopal said. Since April, when the legislative package, including the Delimitation Bill, was defeated by a united Opposition in the Lok Sabha, the seat arithmetic in the House has changed. Twenty TMC MPs broke away and merged with the Nationalist Citizens Party of India (NCPI), pledging support to the NDA. TMC challenged the split, which is currently under Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla’s review. The NCPI faction, on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), 84 days after TMC’s challenge, submitted replies to Mr. Birla, defending its decision and asserting that the move did not violate any parliamentary or constitutional provisions. Six Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs joined the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena. Following the recent alliance between the BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), the lone SAD MP is also expected to vote with the government. It is also learnt that the YSR Congress, which has four MPs in the Lok Sabha, will extend support to the government on the Bill.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In this evolving situation, all eyes are on the DMK, with 22 Lok Sabha MPs, and the NCP (Sharadchandra Pawar), with eight.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Communication (Noun)
संचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Communication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Delimitation (Adjective / Verb)
हदबंदी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Delimitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Proportional (Adjective)
आनुपातिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Proportional' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Amended Delimitation Bill likely to be tabled in special Parliament sitting from November 30", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Centre announces special sitting of Parliament from November 30, 2026, over 100 days since both Houses were adjourned without prorogation; government...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Amended Delimitation Bill likely to be tabled in' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Amended Delimitation Bill likely to be tabled' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Amended Delimitation Bill likely to be tabled' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Centre announces special sitting of Parliament from November 30, 2026, over 100 days since both Houses were adjourned without prorogation; government..." (Hinglish Arth: केंद्र ने 30 नवंबर, 2026 से संसद की विशेष बैठक की घोषणा की, 100 दिनों से अधिक समय से जब दोनों सदनों को सत्रावसान के बिना स्थगित कर दिया गया था; कांग्रेस का कहना है कि सरकार 'ऑपरेशन लोटस' के बाद विधेयक पारित कराने की कोशिश कर रही है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Amended Delimitation Bill likely to be tabled in special Parliament sitting from November 30"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. In this evolving situation, all eyes are on the DMK, with 22 Lok Sabha MPs, and the NCP (Sharadchandra Pawar), with eight.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "In this evolving situation, all eyes are on the DMK, with 22 Lok Sabha MPs, and the NCP (Sharadchandra Pawar), with eight." (Hinglish Arth: इस उभरती स्थिति में, सभी की निगाहें 22 लोकसभा सांसदों वाली डीएमके और आठ सांसदों वाली एनसीपी (शरदचंद्र पवार) पर हैं।)

articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Rajasthan ranks sixth among India’s States with the highest prevalence of child marriage, according to the latest National Family Health Survey (2023-24). Poverty, the lack of education, and entrenched customs such as atta-satta, reinforced by a skewed sex ratio, continue to fuel the practice, particularly in tribal and rural areas. Now, a growing number of girls, empowered by education and greater access to social media, are saying no, reports Ashok Kumar. Meanwhile, the United Nations has declared November 27 as the International Day for the Elimination of Child, Early and Forced Marriage

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nandini (name changed), 16, who lives in Rajasthan’s Sikar, had mapped out her future: finish school, go to college, and get a job to be financially independent. Her family, however, had other plans. Last month, they fixed her wedding without her consent. But the Class 12 student refused to surrender her dreams. She picked up her father’s mobile phone and called the 24x7 child helpline, 1098. Over the next few days, Nandini called the helpline more than six times, using whatever phone she could lay her hands on. Sometimes, she pretended she wanted to speak to her prospective groom; at other times, she sought to contact her friends. But each call carried an urgent message: wedding preparations were under way, guests were being invited, and the date was drawing closer. Help! Each time, the call was connecting to the District Child Protection Office. “She had asked us not to contact her. She said she would call whenever she got a chance. Her first call came just three days before the wedding,” recalls Gargi Sharma, District Child Protection Officer. With barely 72 hours to act, the team secured an injunction order from the court and stopped the wedding. The family was taken by surprise when officials arrived, suspecting that a neighbour had tipped them off. They never imagined that the quiet schoolgirl in their midst had been orchestrating her own rescue. Her identity as the whistleblower remained a secret.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Sikar administration prevented 29 child marriages in 2024 and 10 in 2025. “In 2026, we have received information about 21 cases so far,” Sharma says. But there are many Nandinis, especially in India’s villages, who do not have the education or the agency to say no to child marriage.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Artificial Intelligence (AI) may transform the way Arabic is learned and used, but human emotions and traditional values remain beyond the reach of technology, an international conference on the Arabic language held at Anvarul Islam Arabic College, Kuniyil, observed on Thursday.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The two-day conference, titled ‘Digital humanities: reimagining Arabic language and literature’, was organised by the Arabic department of the college in association with Calicut University’s Arabic department, Kerala State Higher Education Council, and Arab Union of Internet Writers. Liyaqat Ali, deputy director of collegiate education, inaugurated the conference on Wednesday. College Principal K. Mohammed Fawaz presided over the function. Liyaqat Ali, deputy director of collegiate education, inaugurating an international conference on Arabic at Anvarul Islam Arabic College, Kuniyil, on Wednesday. | Photo Credit: SAKEER HUSSAIN Arabic scholars Sumayya Ibrahim Abu Thailath from Palestine, Najeeb Ali Mulkhath from Yemen, Simi K. Salim, K. Ali Noufal, I.P. Abdul Salam, C.M. Sabir Navas, K.A. Nasser, P. Firoz, M.K. Ameer Swalahi, Shakir Babu Kuniyil, and K.P. Abdul Haleem Thangal spoke. E.T. Mohammed Basheer, MP, inaugurated the valedictory function on Thursday. He highlighted the growing global significance of the Arabic language in an increasingly interconnected world.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Scholars Mujeeb Nellikkuth, Ali Jafar, Mohammed Aman K., P. Sulaiman and C. Abdul Wahab spoke.

articles.title: BDO issues residence certificate to mother of child denied birth certificate due to SIR row
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Amina Khatun and Abdul Habib were denied a residence proof necessary for birth certificate on grounds that Abdul Habib’s name was struck off electoral rolls during SIR.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The district administration of Coochbehar district in West Bengal on Thursday (November 26, 2026) issued a residence certificate to the mother of a two-month-old infant, after her parents faced challenges to get the certificate on the ground that the name of the father was deleted from electoral rolls during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) held earlier this year. The Hindu reported on November 25 that the birth certificate was denied to the infant because the father's name was deleted from the electoral roll during SIR. Amina Khatun, wife of Abdul Habib, gave birth to a girl at Dinhata Sub-Divisional Hospital on September 9. Amina Khatun and Abdul Habib approached the hospital and the concerned panchayat office to obtain their daughter’s birth certificate. The couple was reportedly asked to arrange residential verification from the local panchayat pradhan or MLA. On the grounds that the name of Abdul Habib was deleted from the electoral roll in the SIR, the local BJP MLA office refused to give them residence proof. On Thursday (November 26), the BDO office issued a residence certificate to Amina Khatun. “This is to certify that Amina Khatun, wife of Abdul Habib, is a permanent resident of village Khatamari P.O. Khatamari as per the enquiry report of Chowdhurihat Gram Panchayat -. Under Dinhata-II Development Block, P.S.: Sahebganj, Dist.: Cooch Behar. The name of the applicant has been enrolled in the Electoral Roll vide Part-191, Sl. No .848 of 7 Dinhata Assembly Constituency. I wish him/her all success in his/her life,” read the certificate issued by the BDO on Thursday. Abdul Hamid told this correspondent that government officials came to his residence and took him to the BDO office where the residence proof was given to him. “I have received my residence verification certificate which I am going to submit at the hospital tomorrow. Hopefully, my daughter will now get the birth certificate soon,” the father said. There have been allegations of denial of services by the West Bengal government to citizens whose names have been deleted from the electoral rolls during SIR. The Supreme Court, which oversaw the SIR process in the State, had made it clear that removal of a name from the electoral roll cannot be grounds for denial of services. The names of about 36 lakh electors deleted during SIR are pending before SIR tribunals in the State.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / Election Commission of India / government

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 BDO issues residence certificate to mother of child denied birth certificate due to SIR row

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 02:23:07 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Amina Khatun and Abdul Habib were denied a residence proof necessary for birth certificate on grounds that Abdul Habib’s name was struck off electoral rolls during SIR.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The district administration of Coochbehar district in West Bengal on Thursday (November 26, 2026) issued a residence certificate to the mother of a two-month-old infant, after her parents faced challenges to get the certificate on the ground that the name of the father was deleted from electoral rolls during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) held earlier this year. The Hindu reported on November 25 that the birth certificate was denied to the infant because the father's name was deleted from the electoral roll during SIR. Amina Khatun, wife of Abdul Habib, gave birth to a girl at Dinhata Sub-Divisional Hospital on September 9. Amina Khatun and Abdul Habib approached the hospital and the concerned panchayat office to obtain their daughter’s birth certificate. The couple was reportedly asked to arrange residential verification from the local panchayat pradhan or MLA. On the grounds that the name of Abdul Habib was deleted from the electoral roll in the SIR, the local BJP MLA office refused to give them residence proof. On Thursday (November 26), the BDO office issued a residence certificate to Amina Khatun. “This is to certify that Amina Khatun, wife of Abdul Habib, is a permanent resident of village Khatamari P.O. Khatamari as per the enquiry report of Chowdhurihat Gram Panchayat -. Under Dinhata-II Development Block, P.S.: Sahebganj, Dist.: Cooch Behar. The name of the applicant has been enrolled in the Electoral Roll vide Part-191, Sl. No .848 of 7 Dinhata Assembly Constituency. I wish him/her all success in his/her life,” read the certificate issued by the BDO on Thursday. Abdul Hamid told this correspondent that government officials came to his residence and took him to the BDO office where the residence proof was given to him. “I have received my residence verification certificate which I am going to submit at the hospital tomorrow. Hopefully, my daughter will now get the birth certificate soon,” the father said. There have been allegations of denial of services by the West Bengal government to citizens whose names have been deleted from the electoral rolls during SIR. The Supreme Court, which oversaw the SIR process in the State, had made it clear that removal of a name from the electoral roll cannot be grounds for denial of services. The names of about 36 lakh electors deleted during SIR are pending before SIR tribunals in the State.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / Election Commission of India / government

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Administration (Noun)
प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Verification (Noun)
सत्यापन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Verification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Residential (Adjective)
आवासीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Residential' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "BDO issues residence certificate to mother of child denied birth certificate due to SIR row", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Amina Khatun and Abdul Habib were denied a residence proof necessary for birth certificate on grounds that Abdul Habib’s name was struck off...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'BDO issues residence certificate to mother of ch' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'BDO issues residence certificate to mother of' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'BDO issues residence certificate to mother of' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Amina Khatun and Abdul Habib were denied a residence proof necessary for birth certificate on grounds that Abdul Habib’s name was struck off..." (Hinglish Arth: अमीना खातून और अब्दुल हबीब को जन्म प्रमाण पत्र के लिए आवश्यक निवास प्रमाण देने से इस आधार पर इनकार कर दिया गया कि अब्दुल हबीब का नाम एसआईआर के दौरान मतदाता सूची से हटा दिया गया था।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "BDO issues residence certificate to mother of child denied birth certificate due to SIR row"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / Election Commission of India / government.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Large and Medium Industries Minister M.B. Patil held discussions with four Japanese companies, the fourth day of his visit to Japan, focusing on their existing operations in Karnataka and expansion plans

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Large and Medium Industries Minister M.B. Patil held discussions with four Japanese companies on Thursday, the fourth day of his visit to Japan, focusing on their existing operations in Karnataka and expansion plans. According to a release, during a meeting with Seiren Co. Ltd., a manufacturer of automotive interior materials, discussions focused on its manufacturing operations at the Kadakola Industrial Area in Mysuru and its plans to expand its presence in line with Toyota’s growing capacity in the State. articles.title: Leave aside any differences, remove BJP in U.P., says Congress chief
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ‘To win, we all have to fight together and leave aside egoistic talk; we have to strengthen the alliance and remove Modi-Yogi from power,’ said Mallikarjun Kharge

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Thursday (November 26, 2026) in Lucknow urged party leaders and workers to strengthen the Samajwadi Party (SP)-Congress alliance and leave aside any differences in a bid to oust the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Uttar Pradesh. “To win, we all have to fight together and leave aside egoistic talk. We have to strengthen the alliance and remove Modi-Yogi from power. Narendra Modi and Gyanesh Kumar are forming an alliance and snatching the right to vote from the people through Special Intensive Revision (SIR) and EVM manipulation,” said Mr. Kharge, addressing a Constitution Day event at the State Congress office in Lucknow. Highlighting the contribution of the grand old party in the freedom struggle and the deepening of India’s democracy, Mr. Kharge added, “Congress is a party that works together with everyone. It is the result of this collective effort that every citizen of the country has the right to vote today. We fought to save Baba Saheb’s Constitution and our rights through voting in 2024. This time too, if we work unitedly, we will definitely win”. Hitting out at Union Home Minister Amit Shah over allegedly disrespecting Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, the Congress chief added, “Amit Shah said in Parliament, 'It has become fashionable to invoke Baba Saheb Ambedkar’s name. If you had invoked God’s name so much, you would have attained heaven.’ You people yourself are stealing in the name of Lord Ram; you are not going to get heaven”. Later, in the day Congress State unit leaders were detained while taking out Constitution Protection March. “We [Congressmen] were taking out the ‘Constitution Protection March’ peacefully and were detained, but our resolve to protect the Constitution became stronger. The place may change; the paths may be blocked, but the struggle to protect the Constitution has not stopped and will not stop,” said Anil Yadav, a senior Congress leader. Lucknow police took Congress leaders to Lucknow’s Eco Garden and freed in the evening. “The BJP government cannot tolerate even voices raised in support of the Constitution and democracy. The police force’s arrest of Congress leaders and workers who peacefully took to the streets, vowing to defend the Constitution, is deeply shameful. Is it now a crime to demand protection of our Constitution? “Remember, the repression of power cannot erase the values ​​of the Constitution, nor can it silence the voice of democracy. Congress will continue its struggle until the rights of every citizen, the power of every vote, and the Constitution are respected,” said Dwijendra Tripathi, a senior Congress worker based in Lucknow.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Indian National Congress / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / election

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Leave aside any differences, remove BJP in U.P., says Congress chief"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
Indian National Congress / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / election.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Indian National Congress / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / election.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Indian National Congress / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / election." (Hinglish Arth: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस/समाजवादी पार्टी/भारतीय जनता पार्टी/चुनाव)

hinglishTracks.en: ‘To win, we all have to fight together and leave aside egoistic talk; we have to strengthen the alliance and remove Modi-Yogi from power,’ said Mallikarjun Kharge
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — 'जीतने के लिए हम सबको मिलकर लड़ना होगा और अहंकार भरी बातें छोड़नी होंगी; मल्लिकार्जुन खड़गे ने कहा, 'हमें गठबंधन को मजबूत करना है और मोदी-योगी को सत्ता से हटाना है।'।

hinglishTracks.en: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Thursday (November 26, 2026) in Lucknow urged party leaders and workers to strengthen the Samajwadi Party (SP)-Congress alliance and leave aside any differences in a bid to oust the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Uttar Pradesh.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष मल्लिकार्जुन खड़गे ने गुरुवार (नवंबर 26, 2026) को लखनऊ में पार्टी नेताओं और कार्यकर्ताओं से समाजवादी पार्टी (सपा)-कांग्रेस गठबंधन को मजबूत करने और उत्तर प्रदेश में भारतीय जनता पार्टी (भाजपा) को बाहर करने के लिए किसी भी मतभेद को दूर करने का आग्रह किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: “To win, we all have to fight together and leave aside egoistic talk.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “जीतने के लिए हम सभी को एक साथ लड़ना होगा और अहंकारी बातें छोड़नी होंगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: We have to strengthen the alliance and remove Modi-Yogi from power.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हमें गठबंधन को मजबूत करना है और मोदी-योगी को सत्ता से हटाना है.।

hinglishTracks.en: Narendra Modi and Gyanesh Kumar are forming an alliance and snatching the right to vote from the people through Special Intensive Revision (SIR) and EVM manipulation,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — नरेंद्र मोदी और ज्ञानेश कुमार गठबंधन बना रहे हैं और विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (एसआईआर) और ईवीएम हेरफेर के माध्यम से लोगों से वोट देने का अधिकार छीन रहे हैं, ”श्री ने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Manipulation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: चालाकी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Manipulation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Kharge, addressing a Constitution Day event at the State Congress office in Lucknow.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — खड़गे लखनऊ में प्रदेश कांग्रेस कार्यालय में संविधान दिवस कार्यक्रम को संबोधित कर रहे थे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Highlighting the contribution of the grand old party in the freedom struggle and the deepening of India’s democracy, Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — स्वतंत्रता संग्राम और भारत के लोकतंत्र को मजबूत करने में सबसे पुरानी पार्टी के योगदान पर प्रकाश डालते हुए, श्री.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Contribution' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: योगदान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Contribution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Kharge added, “Congress is a party that works together with everyone.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — खड़गे ने कहा, “कांग्रेस एक ऐसी पार्टी है जो सबके साथ मिलकर काम करती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It is the result of this collective effort that every citizen of the country has the right to vote today.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसी सामूहिक प्रयास का नतीजा है कि आज देश के हर नागरिक को वोट देने का अधिकार है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Collective' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सामूहिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Collective' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: We fought to save Baba Saheb’s Constitution and our rights through voting in 2024.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हमने 2024 में वोट के माध्यम से बाबा साहब के संविधान और अपने अधिकारों को बचाने की लड़ाई लड़ी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: This time too, if we work unitedly, we will definitely win”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इस बार भी हम एकजुट होकर काम करेंगे तो निश्चित रूप से जीतेंगे.''।

hinglishTracks.en: Hitting out at Union Home Minister Amit Shah over allegedly disrespecting Dr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कथित तौर पर डॉक्टर का अपमान करने को लेकर केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह पर निशाना साधा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Ambedkar, the Congress chief added, “Amit Shah said in Parliament, 'It has become fashionable to invoke Baba Saheb Ambedkar’s name.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — कांग्रेस प्रमुख अंबेडकर ने कहा, ''अमित शाह ने संसद में कहा, 'बाबा साहेब अंबेडकर का नाम लेना फैशन बन गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: If you had invoked God’s name so much, you would have attained heaven.’ You people yourself are stealing in the name of Lord Ram; you are not going to get heaven”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यदि तुमने इतना ही भगवान का नाम लिया होता तो तुम्हें स्वर्ग मिल गया होता।’ तुम लोग स्वयं ही राम के नाम पर चोरी कर रहे हो; तुम्हे स्वर्ग नहीं मिलेगा”।

hinglishTracks.en: Later, in the day Congress State unit leaders were detained while taking out Constitution Protection March.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — बाद में, दिन में कांग्रेस की राज्य इकाई के नेताओं को संविधान संरक्षण मार्च निकालते समय हिरासत में लिया गया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: “We [Congressmen] were taking out the ‘Constitution Protection March’ peacefully and were detained, but our resolve to protect the Constitution became stronger.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — “हम (कांग्रेसी) शांतिपूर्वक ‘संविधान संरक्षण मार्च’ निकाल रहे थे और हमें हिरासत में ले लिया गया, लेकिन संविधान की रक्षा के लिए हमारा संकल्प और मजबूत हो गया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: The place may change; the paths may be blocked, but the struggle to protect the Constitution has not stopped and will not stop,” said Anil Yadav, a senior Congress leader.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जगह बदल सकती है; रास्ते अवरुद्ध हो सकते हैं, लेकिन संविधान की रक्षा के लिए संघर्ष न रुका है और न रुकेगा, ”कांग्रेस के वरिष्ठ नेता अनिल यादव ने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Lucknow police took Congress leaders to Lucknow’s Eco Garden and freed in the evening.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लखनऊ पुलिस कांग्रेस नेताओं को लखनऊ के इको गार्डन ले गई और शाम को मुक्त कर दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The BJP government cannot tolerate even voices raised in support of the Constitution and democracy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — “भाजपा सरकार संविधान और लोकतंत्र के समर्थन में उठने वाली आवाज़ों को भी बर्दाश्त नहीं कर सकती।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: The police force’s arrest of Congress leaders and workers who peacefully took to the streets, vowing to defend the Constitution, is deeply shameful.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — संविधान की रक्षा की शपथ लेते हुए शांतिपूर्वक सड़कों पर उतरे कांग्रेस नेताओं और कार्यकर्ताओं को पुलिस बल द्वारा गिरफ्तार करना बेहद शर्मनाक है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Is it now a crime to demand protection of our Constitution?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — क्या अब हमारे संविधान की सुरक्षा की मांग करना अपराध है?। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: “Remember, the repression of power cannot erase the values ​​of the Constitution, nor can it silence the voice of democracy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “याद रखें, सत्ता का दमन संविधान के मूल्यों को नहीं मिटा सकता, न ही लोकतंत्र की आवाज़ को दबा सकता है।”। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Congress will continue its struggle until the rights of every citizen, the power of every vote, and the Constitution are respected,” said Dwijendra Tripathi, a senior Congress worker based in Lucknow.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Leave aside any differences, remove BJP in U.P., says Congress chief

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 04:09:06 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: ‘To win, we all have to fight together and leave aside egoistic talk; we have to strengthen the alliance and remove Modi-Yogi from power,’ said Mallikarjun Kharge

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Thursday (November 26, 2026) in Lucknow urged party leaders and workers to strengthen the Samajwadi Party (SP)-Congress alliance and leave aside any differences in a bid to oust the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Uttar Pradesh. “To win, we all have to fight together and leave aside egoistic talk. We have to strengthen the alliance and remove Modi-Yogi from power. Narendra Modi and Gyanesh Kumar are forming an alliance and snatching the right to vote from the people through Special Intensive Revision (SIR) and EVM manipulation,” said Mr. Kharge, addressing a Constitution Day event at the State Congress office in Lucknow. Highlighting the contribution of the grand old party in the freedom struggle and the deepening of India’s democracy, Mr. Kharge added, “Congress is a party that works together with everyone. It is the result of this collective effort that every citizen of the country has the right to vote today. We fought to save Baba Saheb’s Constitution and our rights through voting in 2024. This time too, if we work unitedly, we will definitely win”. Hitting out at Union Home Minister Amit Shah over allegedly disrespecting Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, the Congress chief added, “Amit Shah said in Parliament, 'It has become fashionable to invoke Baba Saheb Ambedkar’s name. If you had invoked God’s name so much, you would have attained heaven.’ You people yourself are stealing in the name of Lord Ram; you are not going to get heaven”. Later, in the day Congress State unit leaders were detained while taking out Constitution Protection March. “We [Congressmen] were taking out the ‘Constitution Protection March’ peacefully and were detained, but our resolve to protect the Constitution became stronger. The place may change; the paths may be blocked, but the struggle to protect the Constitution has not stopped and will not stop,” said Anil Yadav, a senior Congress leader. Lucknow police took Congress leaders to Lucknow’s Eco Garden and freed in the evening. “The BJP government cannot tolerate even voices raised in support of the Constitution and democracy. The police force’s arrest of Congress leaders and workers who peacefully took to the streets, vowing to defend the Constitution, is deeply shameful. Is it now a crime to demand protection of our Constitution? “Remember, the repression of power cannot erase the values ​​of the Constitution, nor can it silence the voice of democracy. Congress will continue its struggle until the rights of every citizen, the power of every vote, and the Constitution are respected,” said Dwijendra Tripathi, a senior Congress worker based in Lucknow.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Indian National Congress / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / election

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Manipulation (Noun)
चालाकी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Manipulation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Contribution (Noun)
योगदान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Contribution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Collective (Adjective)
सामूहिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Collective' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Leave aside any differences, remove BJP in U.P., says Congress chief", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. ‘To win, we all have to fight together and leave aside egoistic talk; we have to strengthen the alliance and remove Modi-Yogi from power,’ said...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Leave aside any differences, remove BJP in U.P.,' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Leave aside any differences, remove BJP in U.' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Leave aside any differences, remove BJP in U.' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "‘To win, we all have to fight together and leave aside egoistic talk; we have to strengthen the alliance and remove Modi-Yogi from power,’ said..." (Hinglish Arth: 'जीतने के लिए हम सबको मिलकर लड़ना होगा और अहंकार भरी बातें छोड़नी होंगी; मल्लिकार्जुन खड़गे ने कहा, 'हमें गठबंधन को मजबूत करना है और मोदी-योगी को सत्ता से हटाना है।')
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Leave aside any differences, remove BJP in U.P., says Congress chief"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Indian National Congress / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / election.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Indian National Congress / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / election." (Hinglish Arth: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस/समाजवादी पार्टी/भारतीय जनता पार्टी/चुनाव)

articles.title: Delhi HC sets aside Centre’s order cancelling FCRA licence of NGO
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ‘Based on the record, this court is unable to discern any material based on which it could be said that the appellant’s activities would likely prejudicially affect the sovereignty, integrity, or security of India or public interest,’ Justice A.J. Bhambhani said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Delhi High Court on Thursday (November 26, 2026) set aside the Centre’s order cancelling the FCRA licence of NGO Socio Legal Information Centre (SLIC), holding that the allegation of the organisation engaging in “aggressive anti-government political activism” was unsupported by any material. Editorial | Troubling bill: On the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026 “Based on the record, this court is unable to discern any material based on which it could be said that the appellant’s activities would likely prejudicially affect the sovereignty, integrity, or security of India or public interest,” Justice A.J. Bhambhani said. The judge added, “The respondent’s allegation that the appellant has indulged in “aggressive anti-government political activism”, is also not based on any material. No documents or other material has been placed on record by the respondent to support that allegation”. Editorial | ​Fear of the foreign: On the FCRA amendments The court further opined that the October 17, 2022 cancellation order the organisation’s FCRA registration was “misconceived, untenable and illegal, apart from being disproportionate and excessive in its rigour and impact”. The court passed the judgment on a plea by the NGO seeking to set aside the October 2022 order of the Ministry of Home Affairs cancelling its Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act registration certificate. The NGO also challenged the freezing of its designated foreign contribution account and its utilisation accounts maintained with several banks across the country. Editorial | Onerous rules: On the amended FCRA Rules, the fallout

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The high court said the violations alleged in the cancellation order principally arise from the conditions for grant of an FCRA registration certificate, the essence of the allegation being that the NGO is guilty of diversion or misutilisation of such funds, or of using such funds for personal gains or diverting them for undesirable purposes.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Delhi HC sets aside Centre’s order cancelling FCRA licence of NGO

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 03:59:46 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: ‘Based on the record, this court is unable to discern any material based on which it could be said that the appellant’s activities would likely prejudicially affect the sovereignty, integrity, or security of India or public interest,’ Justice A.J. Bhambhani said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Delhi High Court on Thursday (November 26, 2026) set aside the Centre’s order cancelling the FCRA licence of NGO Socio Legal Information Centre (SLIC), holding that the allegation of the organisation engaging in “aggressive anti-government political activism” was unsupported by any material. Editorial | Troubling bill: On the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026 “Based on the record, this court is unable to discern any material based on which it could be said that the appellant’s activities would likely prejudicially affect the sovereignty, integrity, or security of India or public interest,” Justice A.J. Bhambhani said. The judge added, “The respondent’s allegation that the appellant has indulged in “aggressive anti-government political activism”, is also not based on any material. No documents or other material has been placed on record by the respondent to support that allegation”. Editorial | ​Fear of the foreign: On the FCRA amendments The court further opined that the October 17, 2022 cancellation order the organisation’s FCRA registration was “misconceived, untenable and illegal, apart from being disproportionate and excessive in its rigour and impact”. The court passed the judgment on a plea by the NGO seeking to set aside the October 2022 order of the Ministry of Home Affairs cancelling its Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act registration certificate. The NGO also challenged the freezing of its designated foreign contribution account and its utilisation accounts maintained with several banks across the country. Editorial | Onerous rules: On the amended FCRA Rules, the fallout

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The high court said the violations alleged in the cancellation order principally arise from the conditions for grant of an FCRA registration certificate, the essence of the allegation being that the NGO is guilty of diversion or misutilisation of such funds, or of using such funds for personal gains or diverting them for undesirable purposes.

articles.title: Jammu and Kashmir’s selection board’s official X handle ‘suspended’ amid anti-board protests over cheating case
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on November 25, 2026, apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting netizens online

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The official X handle of the J&K Service Selection Board (JKSSB) was reportedly suspended on Thursday (November 26, 2026), as protests against the recruitment board continued in the wake of the recent case of cheating during the Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) examination in Jammu. Meanwhile, activists and aspirants, who were seeking postponement of the Sub-Inspector examination, were allegedly detained in Jammu. Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on Wednesday (November 25), apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting netizens online. The JKSSB has not issued any statement on the suspension of its X handle. It had around 129.1K followers. Meanwhile, several aspirants held protests in Jammu against the Board and demanded postponement of the upcoming Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) examination scheduled for November 29. Meanwhile, the Board said it put in place fresh measures to check cheating. It has asked the Deputy Commissioners to appoint invigilation staff through a randomisation process, drawing from a pool of staff already identified. “Exam centres will be allotted to candidates at random, but admit cards will now be available for download only three days before the exam instead of seven,” it said. The magistrates have been tasked to supervise the frisking of candidates and exam staff. All staff deployed at a centre, including service providers, will have to hand in their mobile phones and other gadgets, which will be kept locked in the centre’s control room until the exam ends, it added. The Board also increased jammers at exam centres and pressed CCTV for live monitoring. Unsatisfied by the Board’s assurances, scores of aspirants held street protests in Jammu. Vinkal Sharma, an activist, said, “We demand postponement of the SI examination till the Board maintains transparency.” The J&K Students Association (JKSA) alleged that Mr. Sharma and over a dozen other protesters were detained by the police. “The detentions are deeply unfortunate and unjustified. It is an attempt to suppress legitimate democratic dissent. All detained students and aspirants should be released,” said the Association. Former Member of Parliament Aga Syed Ruhullah, in a post on X, said, “Enough of this blame game between the two power centres. They must stop passing responsibility and start acting. Postpone the November 29 JKPSI examination and constitute an independent SIT to probe the alleged JKSSB FAA irregularities. They are demanding justice, transparency and accountability. Their future cannot be held hostage to administrative failures.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On November 15, the J&K Police busted four “cheating modules” in Jammu during the Board’s examination for the FAA posts. Nearly 1.62 lakh aspirants had appeared for around 600 posts across J&K. The Board has faced more than three major allegations of scams during recruitment examinations in the past six years.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Jammu and Kashmir’s selection board’s official X handle ‘suspended’ amid anti-board protests over cheating case"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
The Board has faced more than three major allegations of scams during recruitment examinations in the past six years.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: The Board has faced more than three major allegations of scams during recruitment examinations in the past six years.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The Board has faced more than three major allegations of scams during recruitment examinations in the past six years." (Hinglish Arth: बोर्ड पर पिछले छह वर्षों में भर्ती परीक्षाओं के दौरान घोटाले के तीन से अधिक बड़े आरोप लगे हैं।)

hinglishTracks.en: Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on November 25, 2026, apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting netizens online
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — आधिकारिक सूत्रों ने कहा कि एक्स पर बोर्ड का आधिकारिक हैंडल 25 नवंबर, 2026 को निलंबित कर दिया गया था, जाहिर तौर पर ऑनलाइन विरोध करने वाले नेटिज़न्स द्वारा बड़े पैमाने पर रिपोर्टिंग के कारण।।

hinglishTracks.en: The official X handle of the J&K Service Selection Board (JKSSB) was reportedly suspended on Thursday (November 26, 2026), as protests against the recruitment board continued in the wake of the recent case of cheating during the Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) examination in Jammu.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जम्मू-कश्मीर सेवा चयन बोर्ड (जेकेएसएसबी) के आधिकारिक एक्स हैंडल को कथित तौर पर गुरुवार (26 नवंबर, 2026) को निलंबित कर दिया गया था, क्योंकि जम्मू में वित्त लेखा सहायक (एफएए) परीक्षा के दौरान धोखाधड़ी के हालिया मामले के मद्देनजर भर्ती बोर्ड के खिलाफ विरोध प्रदर्शन जारी था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: Meanwhile, activists and aspirants, who were seeking postponement of the Sub-Inspector examination, were allegedly detained in Jammu.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इस बीच, सब-इंस्पेक्टर परीक्षा को स्थगित करने की मांग कर रहे कार्यकर्ताओं और उम्मीदवारों को कथित तौर पर जम्मू में हिरासत में लिया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on Wednesday (November 25), apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting netizens online.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — आधिकारिक सूत्रों ने कहा कि एक्स पर बोर्ड का आधिकारिक हैंडल बुधवार (25 नवंबर) को निलंबित कर दिया गया था, जाहिर तौर पर ऑनलाइन विरोध करने वाले नेटिज़न्स द्वारा बड़े पैमाने पर रिपोर्टिंग के कारण।।

hinglishTracks.en: The JKSSB has not issued any statement on the suspension of its X handle.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — जेकेएसएसबी ने अपने एक्स हैंडल के निलंबन पर कोई बयान जारी नहीं किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It had around 129.1K followers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसके करीब 129.1K फॉलोअर्स थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: Meanwhile, several aspirants held protests in Jammu against the Board and demanded postponement of the upcoming Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) examination scheduled for November 29.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इस बीच, कई अभ्यर्थियों ने बोर्ड के खिलाफ जम्मू में विरोध प्रदर्शन किया और 29 नवंबर को होने वाली आगामी पुलिस सब-इंस्पेक्टर (पीएसआई) परीक्षा को स्थगित करने की मांग की।।

hinglishTracks.en: Meanwhile, the Board said it put in place fresh measures to check cheating.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इस बीच, बोर्ड ने कहा कि उसने नकल रोकने के लिए नए उपाय किए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: It has asked the Deputy Commissioners to appoint invigilation staff through a randomisation process, drawing from a pool of staff already identified.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसने उपायुक्तों से कहा है कि वे पहले से ही पहचाने गए कर्मचारियों के एक पूल से, रैंडमाइजेशन प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से निगरानी कर्मचारियों को नियुक्त करें।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Exam centres will be allotted to candidates at random, but admit cards will now be available for download only three days before the exam instead of seven,” it said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसमें कहा गया है, “उम्मीदवारों को परीक्षा केंद्र यादृच्छिक रूप से आवंटित किए जाएंगे, लेकिन प्रवेश पत्र अब परीक्षा से सात के बजाय केवल तीन दिन पहले डाउनलोड के लिए उपलब्ध होंगे।”।

hinglishTracks.en: The magistrates have been tasked to supervise the frisking of candidates and exam staff.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मजिस्ट्रेटों को उम्मीदवारों और परीक्षा कर्मचारियों की तलाशी की निगरानी करने का काम सौंपा गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: All staff deployed at a centre, including service providers, will have to hand in their mobile phones and other gadgets, which will be kept locked in the centre’s control room until the exam ends, it added.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इसमें कहा गया है कि सेवा प्रदाताओं सहित केंद्र पर तैनात सभी कर्मचारियों को अपने मोबाइल फोन और अन्य गैजेट सौंपने होंगे, जिन्हें परीक्षा समाप्त होने तक केंद्र के नियंत्रण कक्ष में बंद रखा जाएगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Board also increased jammers at exam centres and pressed CCTV for live monitoring.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — बोर्ड ने परीक्षा केंद्रों पर जैमर भी बढ़ाए और लाइव निगरानी के लिए सीसीटीवी लगाए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Unsatisfied by the Board’s assurances, scores of aspirants held street protests in Jammu.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — बोर्ड के आश्वासनों से असंतुष्ट, सैकड़ों उम्मीदवारों ने जम्मू में सड़क पर विरोध प्रदर्शन किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Vinkal Sharma, an activist, said, “We demand postponement of the SI examination till the Board maintains transparency.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक कार्यकर्ता विंकल शर्मा ने कहा, "हम बोर्ड द्वारा पारदर्शिता बनाए रखने तक एसआई परीक्षा को स्थगित करने की मांग करते हैं।"।

hinglishTracks.en: The J&K Students Association (JKSA) alleged that Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जेएंडके स्टूडेंट्स एसोसिएशन (जेकेएसए) ने आरोप लगाया कि श्री.।

hinglishTracks.en: Sharma and over a dozen other protesters were detained by the police.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शर्मा और एक दर्जन से अधिक अन्य प्रदर्शनकारियों को पुलिस ने हिरासत में लिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The detentions are deeply unfortunate and unjustified.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “हिरासत अत्यंत दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण और अनुचित है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It is an attempt to suppress legitimate democratic dissent.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह वैध लोकतांत्रिक असहमति को दबाने का प्रयास है।।

hinglishTracks.en: All detained students and aspirants should be released,” said the Association.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हिरासत में लिए गए सभी छात्रों और अभ्यर्थियों को रिहा किया जाना चाहिए, ”एसोसिएशन ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Former Member of Parliament Aga Syed Ruhullah, in a post on X, said, “Enough of this blame game between the two power centres.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पूर्व संसद सदस्य आगा सैयद रुहुल्लाह ने एक्स पर एक पोस्ट में कहा, “दो सत्ता केंद्रों के बीच यह आरोप-प्रत्यारोप का खेल बहुत हो गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: They must stop passing responsibility and start acting.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्हें ज़िम्मेदारी छोड़ना बंद कर देना चाहिए और कार्य करना शुरू करना चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Postpone the November 29 JKPSI examination and constitute an independent SIT to probe the alleged JKSSB FAA irregularities.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 29 नवंबर की जेकेपीएसआई परीक्षा को स्थगित करें और कथित जेकेएसएसबी एफएए अनियमितताओं की जांच के लिए एक स्वतंत्र एसआईटी का गठन करें।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: They are demanding justice, transparency and accountability.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — वे न्याय, पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही की मांग कर रहे हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: Their future cannot be held hostage to administrative failures.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उनके भविष्य को प्रशासनिक विफलताओं का बंधक नहीं बनाया जा सकता।”। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Administrative' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रशासनिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administrative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: On November 15, the J&K Police busted four “cheating modules” in Jammu during the Board’s examination for the FAA posts.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — 15 नवंबर को, जम्मू-कश्मीर पुलिस ने एफएए पदों के लिए बोर्ड की परीक्षा के दौरान जम्मू में चार "धोखाधड़ी मॉड्यूल" का भंडाफोड़ किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Nearly 1.62 lakh aspirants had appeared for around 600 posts across J&K.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जम्मू-कश्मीर में लगभग 600 पदों के लिए लगभग 1.62 लाख अभ्यर्थी उपस्थित हुए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Board has faced more than three major allegations of scams during recruitment examinations in the past six years.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — बोर्ड पर पिछले छह वर्षों में भर्ती परीक्षाओं के दौरान घोटाले के तीन से अधिक बड़े आरोप लगे हैं।।

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Jammu and Kashmir’s selection board’s official X handle ‘suspended’ amid anti-board protests over cheating case

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 02:22:42 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on November 25, 2026, apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting netizens online

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The official X handle of the J&K Service Selection Board (JKSSB) was reportedly suspended on Thursday (November 26, 2026), as protests against the recruitment board continued in the wake of the recent case of cheating during the Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) examination in Jammu. Meanwhile, activists and aspirants, who were seeking postponement of the Sub-Inspector examination, were allegedly detained in Jammu. Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on Wednesday (November 25), apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting netizens online. The JKSSB has not issued any statement on the suspension of its X handle. It had around 129.1K followers. Meanwhile, several aspirants held protests in Jammu against the Board and demanded postponement of the upcoming Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) examination scheduled for November 29. Meanwhile, the Board said it put in place fresh measures to check cheating. It has asked the Deputy Commissioners to appoint invigilation staff through a randomisation process, drawing from a pool of staff already identified. “Exam centres will be allotted to candidates at random, but admit cards will now be available for download only three days before the exam instead of seven,” it said. The magistrates have been tasked to supervise the frisking of candidates and exam staff. All staff deployed at a centre, including service providers, will have to hand in their mobile phones and other gadgets, which will be kept locked in the centre’s control room until the exam ends, it added. The Board also increased jammers at exam centres and pressed CCTV for live monitoring. Unsatisfied by the Board’s assurances, scores of aspirants held street protests in Jammu. Vinkal Sharma, an activist, said, “We demand postponement of the SI examination till the Board maintains transparency.” The J&K Students Association (JKSA) alleged that Mr. Sharma and over a dozen other protesters were detained by the police. “The detentions are deeply unfortunate and unjustified. It is an attempt to suppress legitimate democratic dissent. All detained students and aspirants should be released,” said the Association. Former Member of Parliament Aga Syed Ruhullah, in a post on X, said, “Enough of this blame game between the two power centres. They must stop passing responsibility and start acting. articles.title: Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter and Deputy Secretary of State, has died
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While at the British university, after interning for Time in Moscow, the magazine asked Talbott to help translate the leaked memoirs of Nikita Khrushchev

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Strobe Talbott, a former Time magazine reporter who later served as Deputy Secretary of State under President Bill Clinton and then headed the Brookings Institution, died Thursday (November 26, 2026). He was 80. His son, Devin Talbott, confirmed he passed away peacefully after a long illness in his East Hampton, New York, home. The elder Talbott was educated at Yale and Oxford, where he bunked with Mr. Clinton. While at the British university, after interning for Time in Moscow, the magazine asked Talbott to help translate the leaked memoirs of Nikita Khrushchev, the former first secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, who was ousted in 1964. Talbott did, and it gave him some notoriety as a young man and a job at the magazine. After 21 years at Time , where he focused on Soviet-American relations and held positions including Washington bureau chief and a foreign-affairs columnist, according to his US State Department biography, he received a call from the newly elected Clinton. Then-Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao in conversation with visiting then-U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Strobe Talbot, in New Delhi on April 08, 1994. | Photo Credit: UNI Talbott joined the U.S. State Department in 1994, swiftly becoming Deputy Secretary of State. In that role, he was the architect of the Clinton administration's approach to Russia and other formerly Soviet countries and conducted negotiations between the US and India after the latter's nuclear tests in 1998. Afterward, he served as the president of Brookings from 2002 to 2017. In that time, he also chaired the U.S. State Department's Foreign Affairs Policy Board. Talbott also authored over a dozen books. His last book was titled “Our Founders' Warning: The Age of Reason Meets the Age of Trump,” which was published in 2020.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He was born in Dayton, Ohio, in 1946, and is survived by two sons, Devin and Adrian; stepdaughter Rebecca Ascher-Walsh; siblings Kirk, Marjo and Page Talbott; and eight grandchildren, according to the New York Times.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter and Deputy Secretary of State, has died

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 10:28:12 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While at the British university, after interning for Time in Moscow, the magazine asked Talbott to help translate the leaked memoirs of Nikita Khrushchev

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Strobe Talbott, a former Time magazine reporter who later served as Deputy Secretary of State under President Bill Clinton and then headed the Brookings Institution, died Thursday (November 26, 2026). He was 80. His son, Devin Talbott, confirmed he passed away peacefully after a long illness in his East Hampton, New York, home. The elder Talbott was educated at Yale and Oxford, where he bunked with Mr. Clinton. While at the British university, after interning for Time in Moscow, the magazine asked Talbott to help translate the leaked memoirs of Nikita Khrushchev, the former first secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, who was ousted in 1964. Talbott did, and it gave him some notoriety as a young man and a job at the magazine. After 21 years at Time , where he focused on Soviet-American relations and held positions including Washington bureau chief and a foreign-affairs columnist, according to his US State Department biography, he received a call from the newly elected Clinton. Then-Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao in conversation with visiting then-U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Strobe Talbot, in New Delhi on April 08, 1994. | Photo Credit: UNI Talbott joined the U.S. State Department in 1994, swiftly becoming Deputy Secretary of State. In that role, he was the architect of the Clinton administration's approach to Russia and other formerly Soviet countries and conducted negotiations between the US and India after the latter's nuclear tests in 1998. Afterward, he served as the president of Brookings from 2002 to 2017. In that time, he also chaired the U.S. State Department's Foreign Affairs Policy Board. Talbott also authored over a dozen books. His last book was titled “Our Founders' Warning: The Age of Reason Meets the Age of Trump,” which was published in 2020.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He was born in Dayton, Ohio, in 1946, and is survived by two sons, Devin and Adrian; stepdaughter Rebecca Ascher-Walsh; siblings Kirk, Marjo and Page Talbott; and eight grandchildren, according to the New York Times.

संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized

प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Conversation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Conversation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
University (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'University' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

D. The author contends that 'Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. ✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: Constitution is the guiding force for present, future, says Haryana CM Saini; Congress accuses BJP of undermining democracy
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Respecting the Constitution is not the responsibility of any one political party or government, but the duty of every individual whom the people have entrusted with the opportunity to serve them, said Nayab Singh Saini

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said that the Constitution is the guiding force for our present and future, which has shown the country the right path in overcoming every challenge, even as the Congress party accused the BJP of undermining democratic conventions, the independence of constitutional institutions and the voting rights of citizens. “Over the past 77 years, the Constitution has shown the country the right path in overcoming every challenge. Respecting the Constitution is not the responsibility of any one political party or government, but the duty of every individual whom the people have entrusted with the opportunity to serve them,” said Mr. Saini, addressing the House during the special session of the Haryana State Assembly on the 77th anniversary of the adoption of the Constitution. He said that the true tribute to the framers of the Constitution would be to uphold the democratic path shown by them, maintain its decorum and contribute to building an India where justice is accessible to all, opportunities are available to everyone and the dignity of every citizen is protected. Meanwhile, as part of the party’s nationwide demonstration, Haryana Congress organised a ‘Samvidhan Raksha March’ in Panchkula. Led by AICC In-charge for Haryana Sanjay Dutt, Haryana Pradesh Congress Committee President Rao Narender Singh, and Congress Legislature Party Leader and former Chief Minister Bhupinder Singh Hooda, the march drew senior party leaders. Addressing the gathering, Mr. Dutt said that the country is passing through a decisive phase in which protecting the Constitution and democracy is no longer merely a political issue, but a question concerning the future of the nation. “Intoxicated by its arrogance of power, the BJP government is undermining democratic conventions, the independence of constitutional institutions and the voting rights of citizens. Elections are the greatest expression of democracy. However, when serious questions are raised about the integrity of electoral rolls, complaints emerge regarding the deletion of voters’ names and doubts arise over the transparency of the electoral process, it signals a grave threat to the entire democratic framework.” Mr. Hooda said that any attack on the Constitution is a direct attack on the country’s democratic framework and the rights of its citizens. “The Congress Party will continue its struggle, both on the streets and inside legislatures, to safeguard the Constitution, the independence of constitutional institutions and free and fair elections,” he said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The HPCC president said “The anti-people policies and the BJP Government’s attitude towards democratic institutions have generated widespread public resentment.”

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Constitution is the guiding force for present, future, says Haryana CM Saini; Congress accuses BJP of undermining democracy

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 04:17:00 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Respecting the Constitution is not the responsibility of any one political party or government, but the duty of every individual whom the people have entrusted with the opportunity to serve them, said Nayab Singh Saini

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said that the Constitution is the guiding force for our present and future, which has shown the country the right path in overcoming every challenge, even as the Congress party accused the BJP of undermining democratic conventions, the independence of constitutional institutions and the voting rights of citizens. “Over the past 77 years, the Constitution has shown the country the right path in overcoming every challenge. Respecting the Constitution is not the responsibility of any one political party or government, but the duty of every individual whom the people have entrusted with the opportunity to serve them,” said Mr. Saini, addressing the House during the special session of the Haryana State Assembly on the 77th anniversary of the adoption of the Constitution. He said that the true tribute to the framers of the Constitution would be to uphold the democratic path shown by them, maintain its decorum and contribute to building an India where justice is accessible to all, opportunities are available to everyone and the dignity of every citizen is protected. Meanwhile, as part of the party’s nationwide demonstration, Haryana Congress organised a ‘Samvidhan Raksha March’ in Panchkula. Led by AICC In-charge for Haryana Sanjay Dutt, Haryana Pradesh Congress Committee President Rao Narender Singh, and Congress Legislature Party Leader and former Chief Minister Bhupinder Singh Hooda, the march drew senior party leaders. Addressing the gathering, Mr. Dutt said that the country is passing through a decisive phase in which protecting the Constitution and democracy is no longer merely a political issue, but a question concerning the future of the nation. “Intoxicated by its arrogance of power, the BJP government is undermining democratic conventions, the independence of constitutional institutions and the voting rights of citizens. Elections are the greatest expression of democracy. However, when serious questions are raised about the integrity of electoral rolls, complaints emerge regarding the deletion of voters’ names and doubts arise over the transparency of the electoral process, it signals a grave threat to the entire democratic framework.” Mr. Hooda said that any attack on the Constitution is a direct attack on the country’s democratic framework and the rights of its citizens. “The Congress Party will continue its struggle, both on the streets and inside legislatures, to safeguard the Constitution, the independence of constitutional institutions and free and fair elections,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The HPCC president said “The anti-people policies and the BJP Government’s attitude towards democratic institutions have generated widespread public resentment.”

Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Responsibility (Noun)
ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
