articles.title: Udhayanidhi Stalin meets Tamil Nadu Governor, seeks CBI inquiry against Kallakurichi MLA
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Udhayanidhi also called for preserving all digital evidence and transfer the case to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for an independent and time-bound investigation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tamil Nadu Leader of the Opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin on Thursday (November 26, 2026) submitted a memorandum to Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar at the Lok Bhavan in Chennai, urging him to advise the State government to arrest Kallakurichi MLA C. Arul Vignesh, who has been booked on charges of misbehaving with a woman IAS officer . He also called for preserving all digital evidence and transfer the case to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for an independent and time-bound investigation. Besides, Mr. Udhayanidhi urged the Governor to seek an explanation from the Tamil Nadu government on why a complaint submitted on July 31, 2026, alleging sexual harassment of a District Collector by a ruling-party MLA, was referred to the ruling party’s leadership instead of being forwarded to the police or placed before an Internal Complaints Committee . Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh served summons in sexual harassment case When Jayalalithaa sacked Ministers even before they moved into their official bungalows Tamil Nadu government constitutes four-member ICC for inquiry into complaint against Kallakurichi TVK MLA Later talking to reporters, the DMK leader said the Governor should seek a comprehensive report from the Chief Minister under Article 167(b) of the Constitution on the law and order situation in Tamil Nadu since June 2026, covering every incident cited in the representation and the action taken on each. The DMK also sought the establishment of a dedicated cell with a State-wide alert mechanism to trace missing children; mandatory reporting of every custodial death to the National Human Rights Commission within 24 hours; a magisterial inquiry and a videographed post-mortem in every such case; and the operationalisation of the State Security Commission and the Police Complaints Authority in accordance with the Supreme Court’s directions in the Prakash Singh case. 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: TVK faces criticism from Congress over law and order in Tamil Nadu, allegations against Kallakurichi MLA

📰 Udhayanidhi Stalin meets Tamil Nadu Governor, seeks CBI inquiry against Kallakurichi MLA

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 01:16:01 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Udhayanidhi also called for preserving all digital evidence and transfer the case to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for an independent and time-bound investigation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tamil Nadu Leader of the Opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin on Thursday (November 26, 2026) submitted a memorandum to Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar at the Lok Bhavan in Chennai, urging him to advise the State government to arrest Kallakurichi MLA C. Arul Vignesh, who has been booked on charges of misbehaving with a woman IAS officer . He also called for preserving all digital evidence and transfer the case to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for an independent and time-bound investigation. Besides, Mr. Udhayanidhi urged the Governor to seek an explanation from the Tamil Nadu government on why a complaint submitted on July 31, 2026, alleging sexual harassment of a District Collector by a ruling-party MLA, was referred to the ruling party’s leadership instead of being forwarded to the police or placed before an Internal Complaints Committee . Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh served summons in sexual harassment case When Jayalalithaa sacked Ministers even before they moved into their official bungalows Tamil Nadu government constitutes four-member ICC for inquiry into complaint against Kallakurichi TVK MLA Later talking to reporters, the DMK leader said the Governor should seek a comprehensive report from the Chief Minister under Article 167(b) of the Constitution on the law and order situation in Tamil Nadu since June 2026, covering every incident cited in the representation and the action taken on each. The DMK also sought the establishment of a dedicated cell with a State-wide alert mechanism to trace missing children; mandatory reporting of every custodial death to the National Human Rights Commission within 24 hours; a magisterial inquiry and a videographed post-mortem in every such case; and the operationalisation of the State Security Commission and the Police Complaints Authority in accordance with the Supreme Court’s directions in the Prakash Singh case. articles.title: Amid wildlife deaths, Keralam Forest dept warns Sabarimala pilgrims against littering on Pamba route
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Two bonnet macaques and a Nilgiri langur died after being hit by vehicles on the route between November 16 and 23, officials said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Keralam Forest Department on Thursday urged Sabarimala pilgrims travelling along the Nilakkal-Pamba route not to throw food waste and plastic materials from vehicles, warning that littering is attracting wild animals to the road and increasing the risk of road accidents, officials said. Two bonnet macaques and a Nilgiri langur died after being hit by vehicles on the route between November 16 and 23, officials said. Assistant Conservator of Forests Manu Sathyan, in a statement, said the Nilgiri langur is a Schedule I species under the Wildlife Protection Act and primarily lives in trees. The 19-km Nilakkal-Pamba road passes through forest areas, and the widening and asphalting of the road have increased the risk of vehicles travelling at high speeds, he said. The department has recommended additional speed-control measures and the deployment of more sanitation workers in coordination with the Ranni Forest Division. He has also appealed to pilgrims not to throw food waste or plastic materials from vehicles, as these attract monkeys and other wild animals to the roadside, exposing them to the danger of being run over. The department has called for greater awareness among pilgrims and improved waste management along the route to prevent further wildlife deaths. Meanwhile, the Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) said that a 7,000-square-foot resting facility for pilgrims has been developed at Lower Appachimedu along the Sabarimala trekking route, providing space for up to 1,000 devotees to rest during their arduous climb to the Ayyappa temple. Located near the existing offering centre, the facility has been developed with tiled flooring, steel benches, and built-in seating.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A drinking water kiosk and toilets have also been provided for the convenience of pilgrims.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Amid wildlife deaths, Keralam Forest dept warns Sabarimala pilgrims against littering on Pamba route

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 01:15:44 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Two bonnet macaques and a Nilgiri langur died after being hit by vehicles on the route between November 16 and 23, officials said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Keralam Forest Department on Thursday urged Sabarimala pilgrims travelling along the Nilakkal-Pamba route not to throw food waste and plastic materials from vehicles, warning that littering is attracting wild animals to the road and increasing the risk of road accidents, officials said. Two bonnet macaques and a Nilgiri langur died after being hit by vehicles on the route between November 16 and 23, officials said. Assistant Conservator of Forests Manu Sathyan, in a statement, said the Nilgiri langur is a Schedule I species under the Wildlife Protection Act and primarily lives in trees. The 19-km Nilakkal-Pamba road passes through forest areas, and the widening and asphalting of the road have increased the risk of vehicles travelling at high speeds, he said. The department has recommended additional speed-control measures and the deployment of more sanitation workers in coordination with the Ranni Forest Division. He has also appealed to pilgrims not to throw food waste or plastic materials from vehicles, as these attract monkeys and other wild animals to the roadside, exposing them to the danger of being run over. The department has called for greater awareness among pilgrims and improved waste management along the route to prevent further wildlife deaths. Meanwhile, the Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) said that a 7,000-square-foot resting facility for pilgrims has been developed at Lower Appachimedu along the Sabarimala trekking route, providing space for up to 1,000 devotees to rest during their arduous climb to the Ayyappa temple. Located near the existing offering centre, the facility has been developed with tiled flooring, steel benches, and built-in seating.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A drinking water kiosk and toilets have also been provided for the convenience of pilgrims.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Department' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: SpaceX did ​not immediately respond ‌to a request for comment on whether Mr. Musk’s SpaceX share donations would be linked to Trump Accounts or ‌come with any kind of ​lockup period

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk ​said on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) in a post ‌on X that every child in ​the U.S. would receive two ⁠shares — one from the company and one from him personally. SpaceX said earlier in ‌the day it would contribute one newly issued share of its ‌Class A common stock ‌to ⁠every currently active Trump Account, adding ⁠that Mr. Musk will personally match the number of shares donated by the company. SpaceX did ​not immediately respond ‌to a request for comment on whether Mr. Musk’s SpaceX share donations would be linked to Trump Accounts or ‌come with any kind of ​lockup period. In October, SpaceX president Gwynne Shotwell and her ⁠husband pledged a share of their SpaceX stock to each of more ‌than 2 million children under the Trump initiative. Mr. Musk said last month he would give one of his SpaceX shares to every child in America. “Next year, I will give one ‌of my SpaceX shares to every ​kid in America. This will be the first of many,” Mr. Musk, ⁠who runs Anthropic rival SpaceXSI, said in ⁠a post on X.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Giving shares, which are stakes in ‌the future economy, directly to the people is the way,” Mr. Musk ​added.

articles.title: FedEx airplane overruns runway at Miami airport, closing all but one runway
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: There were no reports of injuries after the plane ran off the runway at about 8.40 p.m., the airport reported

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A FedEx airplane overran a runway at the Miami International Airport on Wednesday night (November 25, 2026), forcing all but one runway to temporarily close the day before Thanksgiving, according to officials. There were no reports of injuries after the plane ran off the runway at about 8.40 p.m., the airport reported. Miami-Dade Fire Rescue units have responded. The incident happened almost three months after an Amazon cargo jet overshot another runway in Miami, killing five people on the ground. The McDonnell Douglas MD-11 was coming from Memphis, and flights will be resuming shortly, according to the Federal Aviation Administration. The administration will investigate. FedEx said the plane had “an issue upon landing” and that it is coordinating with investigating officials. “We are grateful that our crew is safe and there are no reported injuries,” the company said in a statement. FedEx had just started flying MD-11s again in May to deliver packages after that type of plane crashed in Kentucky last year as it was taking off. The UPS plane's left engine flew off and three pilots along with 12 people on the ground were killed. The FAA had approved Boeing's proposed fix for the MD-11s “after extensive review.” The airport recommended that passengers scheduled to fly Wednesday night should check with their airlines for the latest flight updates before travelling to the airport. “We appreciate our passengers' patience as we work to safely resume normal operations,” the airport said in a statement. The runway this FedEx plane landed on Wednesday is different than the one the Amazon cargo plane overran in September. But three of Miami's runways converge at the west end, so the FedEx plane ended up close to where the Amazon plane careened across a road and struck a van filled with a plane cleaning crew.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The incident also comes less than two weeks after a minor collision between two planes at a taxiway intersection at the Miami airport. The wing of the Copa flight and the nose of the UPS plane collided.

articles.title: Cyril Ramaphosa wins court bid to overturn impeachment report

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The 74-year-old leader was accused of hiding from police and tax authorities a 2020 break-in and theft of $580,000, which was stashed in furniture at his luxury Phala Phala farmhouse in the northern Limpopo province

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A South African court ruled on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) in favour of President Cyril Ramaphosa , overturning a 2022 report that found he may have a case to answer over the theft of large sums of foreign currency from his private farm. The 74-year-old leader was accused of hiding from police and tax authorities a 2020 break-in and theft of $580,000, which was stashed in furniture at his luxury Phala Phala farmhouse in the northern Limpopo province. An independent parliamentary panel found that Mr. Ramaphosa may have committed serious misconduct, but he survived a National Assembly vote that could have triggered proceedings to remove him from office. He challenged the panel’s report after the Constitutional Court ruled that parliament had violated the constitution by blocking efforts to impeach him. On Wednesday (November 25, 2026), the high court said the report could not stand, ruling that the panel “went beyond its lawful remit, asked itself wrong questions, and made several material errors of law”. “Any steps taken by the National Assembly pursuant to the report are reviewed, declared unlawful and set aside,” judge Nolwazi Mabindla-Boqwana ruled. The complaint against Mr. Ramaphosa was laid by a former spy boss and one-time ally of Mr. Ramaphosa’s predecessor, Jacob Zuma, who claimed Mr. Ramaphosa hid a robbery of $4 million from police and tax authorities. Mr. Ramaphosa, a former anti-apartheid activist who became a businessman before entering politics, denied any wrongdoing, saying he reported the break-in to the police and that the money came from the sale of 20 buffaloes. The scandal nearly cost him the leadership of the African National Congress (ANC) in late 2022, but a motion against him was defeated in parliament, where the party held a majority.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The public prosecutor dropped the charges in 2024.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Cyril Ramaphosa wins court bid to overturn impeachment report

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 12:42:41 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The 74-year-old leader was accused of hiding from police and tax authorities a 2020 break-in and theft of $580,000, which was stashed in furniture at his luxury Phala Phala farmhouse in the northern Limpopo province

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A South African court ruled on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) in favour of President Cyril Ramaphosa , overturning a 2022 report that found he may have a case to answer over the theft of large sums of foreign currency from his private farm. The 74-year-old leader was accused of hiding from police and tax authorities a 2020 break-in and theft of $580,000, which was stashed in furniture at his luxury Phala Phala farmhouse in the northern Limpopo province. An independent parliamentary panel found that Mr. Ramaphosa may have committed serious misconduct, but he survived a National Assembly vote that could have triggered proceedings to remove him from office. He challenged the panel’s report after the Constitutional Court ruled that parliament had violated the constitution by blocking efforts to impeach him. On Wednesday (November 25, 2026), the high court said the report could not stand, ruling that the panel “went beyond its lawful remit, asked itself wrong questions, and made several material errors of law”. “Any steps taken by the National Assembly pursuant to the report are reviewed, declared unlawful and set aside,” judge Nolwazi Mabindla-Boqwana ruled. The complaint against Mr. Ramaphosa was laid by a former spy boss and one-time ally of Mr. Ramaphosa’s predecessor, Jacob Zuma, who claimed Mr. Ramaphosa hid a robbery of $4 million from police and tax authorities. Mr. Ramaphosa, a former anti-apartheid activist who became a businessman before entering politics, denied any wrongdoing, saying he reported the break-in to the police and that the money came from the sale of 20 buffaloes. The scandal nearly cost him the leadership of the African National Congress (ANC) in late 2022, but a motion against him was defeated in parliament, where the party held a majority.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The public prosecutor dropped the charges in 2024.

articles.title: Sheikh Hasina’s return gambit tests Bangladesh’s political fault lines
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ousted leader’s December 16 return plan has energised the Awami League leaders and cadre, tested Tarique Rahman’s government and complicated Dhaka’s efforts to reset ties with New Delhi

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Mahmud Tanzid, a 27-year-old private-sector employee in Dhaka, has postponed a trip he had planned for the first week of December. After weeks of unrest, particularly in Gopalganj, and with former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina announcing her intention to return to Bangladesh on December 16, he fears the situation could deteriorate further. He is no longer certain what the coming weeks will bring as Ms. Hasina’s Awami League has already called a nationwide lockdown on November 29-30. Whether Ms. Hasina actually lands in Dhaka on December 16 or not, she has already reshaped Bangladesh’s political calendar. Her announcement has turned the countdown to Victory Day, which marks the end of the nine-month Liberation War in 1971 and the official surrender of Pakistani forces to the joint command of Bangladeshi and Indian forces, into a test of political will. The 79-year-old former Prime Minister intends to end more than two years of exile in India on Victory Day. It is the first time she has specified a date for her return. In doing so, the Awami League, which was banned by the post-Hasina interim administration, has transformed what began as a localised law-and-order crisis into a national contest over political legitimacy. The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) government’s response has been uncompromising. State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humayun Kobir said Ms. Hasina could return only through extradition, effectively “in handcuffs”. Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed reiterated the government’s position on Wednesday (November 25), saying “a convicted fugitive” could return only through the extradition process.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Dismissing the shifting deadlines — initially November, then December, and now December 16 — Mr. Ahmed said the government felt “no worry or pressure” and that law enforcement agencies remained on constant alert. He warned that the Awami League would face strict legal action if it resorted to militancy, arson or attacks on people and property.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Sheikh Hasina’s return gambit tests Bangladesh’s political fault lines

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 01:30:29 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The ousted leader’s December 16 return plan has energised the Awami League leaders and cadre, tested Tarique Rahman’s government and complicated Dhaka’s efforts to reset ties with New Delhi

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Mahmud Tanzid, a 27-year-old private-sector employee in Dhaka, has postponed a trip he had planned for the first week of December. After weeks of unrest, particularly in Gopalganj, and with former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina announcing her intention to return to Bangladesh on December 16, he fears the situation could deteriorate further. He is no longer certain what the coming weeks will bring as Ms. Hasina’s Awami League has already called a nationwide lockdown on November 29-30. Whether Ms. Hasina actually lands in Dhaka on December 16 or not, she has already reshaped Bangladesh’s political calendar. Her announcement has turned the countdown to Victory Day, which marks the end of the nine-month Liberation War in 1971 and the official surrender of Pakistani forces to the joint command of Bangladeshi and Indian forces, into a test of political will. The 79-year-old former Prime Minister intends to end more than two years of exile in India on Victory Day. It is the first time she has specified a date for her return. In doing so, the Awami League, which was banned by the post-Hasina interim administration, has transformed what began as a localised law-and-order crisis into a national contest over political legitimacy. The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) government’s response has been uncompromising. State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humayun Kobir said Ms. Hasina could return only through extradition, effectively “in handcuffs”. Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed reiterated the government’s position on Wednesday (November 25), saying “a convicted fugitive” could return only through the extradition process.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Dismissing the shifting deadlines — initially November, then December, and now December 16 — Mr. Ahmed said the government felt “no worry or pressure” and that law enforcement agencies remained on constant alert. He warned that the Awami League would face strict legal action if it resorted to militancy, arson or attacks on people and property.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Enforcement (Noun)
सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना।
✓ Syn: Implementation, Execution, Administration  |  ✖ Ant: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver
Administration (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Administration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Announcement (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Announcement' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Extradition (Noun)
प्रत्यर्पण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Extradition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "Sheikh Hasina’s return gambit tests Bangladesh’s political fault lines", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The ousted leader’s December 16 return plan has energised the Awami League leaders and cadre, tested Tarique Rahman’s government and complicated...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Sheikh Hasina’s return gambit tests Bangladesh’s' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Sheikh Hasina’s return gambit tests Banglades' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Sheikh Hasina’s return gambit tests Banglades' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The ousted leader’s December 16 return plan has energised the Awami League leaders and cadre, tested Tarique Rahman’s government and complicated..." (Hinglish Arth: अपदस्थ नेता की 16 दिसंबर की वापसी योजना ने अवामी लीग के नेताओं और कैडर को उत्साहित कर दिया है, तारिक रहमान की सरकार का परीक्षण किया है और नई दिल्ली के साथ संबंधों को फिर से स्थापित करने के ढाका के प्रयासों को जटिल बना दिया है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Sheikh Hasina’s return gambit tests Bangladesh’s political fault lines"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. He warned that the Awami League would face strict legal action if it resorted to militancy, arson or attacks on people and property.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "He warned that the Awami League would face strict legal action if it resorted to militancy, arson or attacks on people and property." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने चेतावनी दी कि अगर अवामी लीग ने उग्रवाद, आगजनी या लोगों और संपत्ति पर हमले का सहारा लिया तो उसे सख्त कानूनी कार्रवाई का सामना करना पड़ेगा।)

articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The law places a legal duty on online services to protect users from serious harm; but the conservative opposition and the United States say the law could lead to censorship of lawful speech

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: The Australian Parliament, on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), passed the Digital Duty of Care Bill 2026, which makes online services such as games, apps, social media platforms and AI chatbots legally responsible for keeping users safe. Companies that violate the law face fines of up to 5% of their global turnover, or A$109.2 million, whichever is greater. The law amends the Online Safety Act 2021, replacing the existing patchwork of online safety codes and standards and Basic Online Safety Expectations with a single, enforceable duty of care. The move follows the under-16 social media ban, which Parliament passed in 2024 and which took effect in December 2025.

📰 Australia’s Digital Duty of Care law: Why Big Tech is under pressure

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 12:22:42 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The law places a legal duty on online services to protect users from serious harm; but the conservative opposition and the United States say the law could lead to censorship of lawful speech

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: The Australian Parliament, on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), passed the Digital Duty of Care Bill 2026, which makes online services such as games, apps, social media platforms and AI chatbots legally responsible for keeping users safe. Companies that violate the law face fines of up to 5% of their global turnover, or A$109.2 million, whichever is greater. The law amends the Online Safety Act 2021, replacing the existing patchwork of online safety codes and standards and Basic Online Safety Expectations with a single, enforceable duty of care. The move follows the under-16 social media ban, which Parliament passed in 2024 and which took effect in December 2025.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: technology (general) / Australia / The Hindu Explains / safety of citizens / law / internet / social media

articles.title: Private buses in Keralam reported for violations on the new web app Idi Vandi
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Developed by Bengaluru-based Malayali Hrishikesh Vinod, the web app has received over 600 complaints in a week since going live

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For someone who drives/rides in Keralam, the interface of the web app idivandi.com would look like a rogues’ gallery with photographs of buses, and the accompanying ‘music’ is the sound of horns blaring from private buses plying State roads. Road users have ‘reported’ these buses for traffic violations including rash driving, speeding, and/or blaring their horns. Since going live more than a week ago, users have already registered 679 complaints against 491 buses across Keralam. The web app, developed using AI tools, began as Bengaluru-based Hrishikesh Vinod’s way of venting about a private bus that rear-ended his brand-new car in April this year. When Hrishikesh, who runs a marketing agency, bought a new car, he wanted to show it to his mother at Kappad, in Kannur, Keralam. “I brought it to Kannur, and within three days the incident happened. This was my way of venting. I did it for myself; I didn't intend to make it public. But what happened to Akshara S, who was run over by a private bus in Kochi on November 4, and what her husband, Varun, posted on social media about losing her struck a chord. A spate of other incidents involving private buses also prompted me to throw the app open to the public,” says Hrishikesh. Hrishikesh Vinod, who developed the Idi Vandi web app | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT He clarifies that he doesn't mean to malign bus drivers or owners, but to demand accountability. “This is not designed to hassle or get them into trouble; I want them to spare some thought for their behaviour and how they treat others using the roads.” Idi vandi is colloquial for rashly driven buses, which cause accidents. All complaints and incidents are verified using AI. “I have set up several firewalls so that people do not use this website as a platform to settle personal scores.” For instance, a person cannot make more than two complaints a day. There are more than 20 criteria for complaints, including racing, rash driving, honking, harassing passengers, and dangerous overtaking. Each offence comes with a score or ‘idi points’: rear-ending gets five points, causing an accident gets a score of six, a bus that causes a fatality gains 10 points, and so on. There is even a leaderboard of buses with the most violations. Apart from complaining on the website, which will be forwarded after mandatory vetting to the concerned Road Transport Office (RTO), there is also the option of making a direct complaint. This will be anonymous; only idivandi.com and the Motor Vehicle Department (MVD) will have access to the complainant’s details. So far, Idi Vandi has sent 15 complaints to RTOs across Keralam. The offices have received only three responses. “If a bus racks up more than three complaints, an email is sent to the RTO, with a reminder every 30 days.” Since he has just gone live, he is considering options about what to do if there is no response. An option he is considering is filing an RTI application, asking what action has been taken, if the two follow-up requests are ignored.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Think about it… there would be 2000-odd private buses plying on our roads along various routes. If there are complaints against 400-plus of these, it is a huge number of violations!” It is not all errant buses on Idi Vandi; a Nalla Vandi section lists buses that have been ‘good ’, like helping passengers and showing kindness to students and the disabled.

hinglishTracks.en: For someone who drives/rides in Keralam, the interface of the web app idivandi.com would look like a rogues’ gallery with photographs of buses, and the accompanying ‘music’ is the sound of horns blaring from private buses plying State roads.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — केरल में गाड़ी चलाने/सवारी करने वाले किसी व्यक्ति के लिए, वेब ऐप idivandi.com का इंटरफ़ेस बसों की तस्वीरों वाली एक दुष्ट गैलरी की तरह दिखेगा, और साथ में 'संगीत' राज्य की सड़कों पर चलने वाली निजी बसों से बजने वाले हॉर्न की आवाज़ है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Road users have ‘reported’ these buses for traffic violations including rash driving, speeding, and/or blaring their horns.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सड़क उपयोगकर्ताओं ने इन बसों पर लापरवाही से गाड़ी चलाने, तेज़ गति से गाड़ी चलाने और/या हॉर्न बजाने सहित यातायात उल्लंघनों की 'रिपोर्ट' की है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Since going live more than a week ago, users have already registered 679 complaints against 491 buses across Keralam.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एक सप्ताह से अधिक समय पहले लाइव होने के बाद से, उपयोगकर्ता पहले ही केरलम में 491 बसों के खिलाफ 679 शिकायतें दर्ज कर चुके हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The web app, developed using AI tools, began as Bengaluru-based Hrishikesh Vinod’s way of venting about a private bus that rear-ended his brand-new car in April this year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एआई टूल्स का उपयोग करके विकसित किया गया वेब ऐप, बेंगलुरु स्थित हृषिकेश विनोद के एक निजी बस के बारे में बताने के तरीके के रूप में शुरू हुआ, जिसने इस साल अप्रैल में उनकी ब्रांड-नई कार को पीछे से खत्म कर दिया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: When Hrishikesh, who runs a marketing agency, bought a new car, he wanted to show it to his mother at Kappad, in Kannur, Keralam.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जब मार्केटिंग एजेंसी चलाने वाले हृषिकेश ने एक नई कार खरीदी, तो वह इसे केरल के कन्नूर में कप्पड़ में अपनी मां को दिखाना चाहते थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: “I brought it to Kannur, and within three days the incident happened.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “मैं इसे कन्नूर ले आया और तीन दिनों के भीतर यह घटना घट गई।।

hinglishTracks.en: This was my way of venting.

hinglishTracks.en: I did it for myself; I didn't intend to make it public.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मैंने इसे अपने लिए किया; मेरा इरादा इसे सार्वजनिक करने का नहीं था.।

hinglishTracks.en: But what happened to Akshara S, who was run over by a private bus in Kochi on November 4, and what her husband, Varun, posted on social media about losing her struck a chord.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लेकिन अक्षरा एस के साथ जो हुआ, वह 4 नवंबर को कोच्चि में एक निजी बस से कुचल गई थी, और उसके पति वरुण ने उसे खोने के बारे में सोशल मीडिया पर जो पोस्ट किया, उसने दिल दहला दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: A spate of other incidents involving private buses also prompted me to throw the app open to the public,” says Hrishikesh.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — निजी बसों से जुड़ी कई अन्य घटनाओं ने भी मुझे ऐप को जनता के लिए खोलने के लिए प्रेरित किया,'' हृषिकेश कहते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हृषिकेश विनोद, जिन्होंने ईदी वंडी वेब ऐप विकसित किया | फोटो साभार: विशेष व्यवस्था। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Arrangement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Arrangement' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: He clarifies that he doesn't mean to malign bus drivers or owners, but to demand accountability.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने स्पष्ट किया कि उनका इरादा बस चालकों या मालिकों को बदनाम करना नहीं है, बल्कि जवाबदेही की मांग करना है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: “This is not designed to hassle or get them into trouble; I want them to spare some thought for their behaviour and how they treat others using the roads.” Idi vandi is colloquial for rashly driven buses, which cause accidents.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — "यह उन्हें परेशान करने या मुसीबत में डालने के लिए नहीं बनाया गया है; मैं चाहता हूं कि वे अपने व्यवहार और सड़कों पर दूसरों के साथ कैसा व्यवहार करते हैं, इस पर कुछ विचार करें।" ईदी वंडी लापरवाही से चलने वाली बसों के लिए बोलचाल की भाषा है, जो दुर्घटनाओं का कारण बनती हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Colloquial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Colloquial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: All complaints and incidents are verified using AI.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सभी शिकायतों और घटनाओं को एआई का उपयोग करके सत्यापित किया जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “I have set up several firewalls so that people do not use this website as a platform to settle personal scores.” For instance, a person cannot make more than two complaints a day.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — "मैंने कई फ़ायरवॉल स्थापित किए हैं ताकि लोग इस वेबसाइट का उपयोग व्यक्तिगत हिसाब-किताब तय करने के लिए एक मंच के रूप में न करें।" उदाहरण के लिए, एक व्यक्ति एक दिन में दो से अधिक शिकायतें नहीं कर सकता।।

hinglishTracks.en: There are more than 20 criteria for complaints, including racing, rash driving, honking, harassing passengers, and dangerous overtaking.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शिकायतों के लिए 20 से अधिक मानदंड हैं, जिनमें रेसिंग, लापरवाही से गाड़ी चलाना, हॉर्न बजाना, यात्रियों को परेशान करना और खतरनाक ओवरटेकिंग शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Each offence comes with a score or ‘idi points’: rear-ending gets five points, causing an accident gets a score of six, a bus that causes a fatality gains 10 points, and so on.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — प्रत्येक अपराध एक अंक या 'आईडीआई अंक' के साथ आता है: पीछे वाले को पांच अंक मिलते हैं, दुर्घटना का कारण बनने वाली बस को छह अंक मिलते हैं, जिस बस के कारण दुर्घटना होती है उसे 10 अंक मिलते हैं, इत्यादि।।

hinglishTracks.en: There is even a leaderboard of buses with the most violations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यहां तक ​​कि सबसे अधिक उल्लंघन वाली बसों का एक लीडरबोर्ड भी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Apart from complaining on the website, which will be forwarded after mandatory vetting to the concerned Road Transport Office (RTO), there is also the option of making a direct complaint.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — वेबसाइट पर शिकायत करने के अलावा, जिसे संबंधित सड़क परिवहन कार्यालय (आरटीओ) को अनिवार्य जांच के बाद भेजा जाएगा, सीधे शिकायत करने का विकल्प भी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: This will be anonymous; only idivandi.com and the Motor Vehicle Department (MVD) will have access to the complainant’s details.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह गुमनाम होगा; केवल idivandi.com और मोटर वाहन विभाग (एमवीडी) के पास शिकायतकर्ता के विवरण तक पहुंच होगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: So far, Idi Vandi has sent 15 complaints to RTOs across Keralam.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अब तक, इदी वांडी ने पूरे केरलम में आरटीओ को 15 शिकायतें भेजी हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The offices have received only three responses.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — कार्यालयों को केवल तीन प्रतिक्रियाएँ प्राप्त हुई हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: “If a bus racks up more than three complaints, an email is sent to the RTO, with a reminder every 30 days.” Since he has just gone live, he is considering options about what to do if there is no response.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — "यदि किसी बस में तीन से अधिक शिकायतें आती हैं, तो हर 30 दिनों में एक अनुस्मारक के साथ आरटीओ को एक ईमेल भेजा जाता है।" चूँकि वह अभी-अभी लाइव हुआ है, इसलिए वह विकल्पों पर विचार कर रहा है कि अगर कोई प्रतिक्रिया नहीं मिलती है तो क्या किया जाए।।

hinglishTracks.en: An option he is considering is filing an RTI application, asking what action has been taken, if the two follow-up requests are ignored.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — वह जिस विकल्प पर विचार कर रहे हैं वह एक आरटीआई आवेदन दाखिल करना है, जिसमें पूछा जाएगा कि यदि दो अनुवर्ती अनुरोधों को नजरअंदाज कर दिया गया तो क्या कार्रवाई की गई है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Application' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Application' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: “Think about it… there would be 2000-odd private buses plying on our roads along various routes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — “इसके बारे में सोचें… हमारी सड़कों पर विभिन्न मार्गों पर लगभग 2000 निजी बसें चल रही होंगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: If there are complaints against 400-plus of these, it is a huge number of violations!” It is not all errant buses on Idi Vandi; a Nalla Vandi section lists buses that have been ‘good ’, like helping passengers and showing kindness to students and the disabled.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — यदि इनमें से 400 से अधिक के खिलाफ शिकायतें हैं, तो यह उल्लंघनों की एक बड़ी संख्या है!” ईदी वंडी पर सभी गलत बसें नहीं हैं; नल्ला वंडी अनुभाग उन बसों को सूचीबद्ध करता है जो 'अच्छी' रही हैं, जैसे यात्रियों की मदद करना और छात्रों और विकलांगों के प्रति दया दिखाना।।

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Private buses in Keralam reported for violations on the new web app Idi Vandi

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 12:01:32 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Developed by Bengaluru-based Malayali Hrishikesh Vinod, the web app has received over 600 complaints in a week since going live

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For someone who drives/rides in Keralam, the interface of the web app idivandi.com would look like a rogues’ gallery with photographs of buses, and the accompanying ‘music’ is the sound of horns blaring from private buses plying State roads. Road users have ‘reported’ these buses for traffic violations including rash driving, speeding, and/or blaring their horns. Since going live more than a week ago, users have already registered 679 complaints against 491 buses across Keralam. The web app, developed using AI tools, began as Bengaluru-based Hrishikesh Vinod’s way of venting about a private bus that rear-ended his brand-new car in April this year. When Hrishikesh, who runs a marketing agency, bought a new car, he wanted to show it to his mother at Kappad, in Kannur, Keralam. “I brought it to Kannur, and within three days the incident happened. This was my way of venting. I did it for myself; I didn't intend to make it public. But what happened to Akshara S, who was run over by a private bus in Kochi on November 4, and what her husband, Varun, posted on social media about losing her struck a chord. A spate of other incidents involving private buses also prompted me to throw the app open to the public,” says Hrishikesh. Hrishikesh Vinod, who developed the Idi Vandi web app | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT He clarifies that he doesn't mean to malign bus drivers or owners, but to demand accountability. “This is not designed to hassle or get them into trouble; I want them to spare some thought for their behaviour and how they treat others using the roads.” Idi vandi is colloquial for rashly driven buses, which cause accidents. All complaints and incidents are verified using AI. “I have set up several firewalls so that people do not use this website as a platform to settle personal scores.” For instance, a person cannot make more than two complaints a day. There are more than 20 criteria for complaints, including racing, rash driving, honking, harassing passengers, and dangerous overtaking. Each offence comes with a score or ‘idi points’: rear-ending gets five points, causing an accident gets a score of six, a bus that causes a fatality gains 10 points, and so on. There is even a leaderboard of buses with the most violations. Apart from complaining on the website, which will be forwarded after mandatory vetting to the concerned Road Transport Office (RTO), there is also the option of making a direct complaint. This will be anonymous; only idivandi.com and the Motor Vehicle Department (MVD) will have access to the complainant’s details. So far, Idi Vandi has sent 15 complaints to RTOs across Keralam. The offices have received only three responses. “If a bus racks up more than three complaints, an email is sent to the RTO, with a reminder every 30 days.” Since he has just gone live, he is considering options about what to do if there is no response. An option he is considering is filing an RTI application, asking what action has been taken, if the two follow-up requests are ignored.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Think about it… there would be 2000-odd private buses plying on our roads along various routes. articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Developed by Bengaluru-based Malayali Hrishikesh Vinod, the web app has received over 600 complaints in a week since going live
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For someone who drives/rides in Keralam, the interface of the web app idivandi.com would look like a rogues’ gallery with photographs of buses, and the accompanying ‘music’ is the sound of horns blaring from private buses plying State roads. Road users have ‘reported’ these buses for traffic violations including rash driving, speeding, and/or blaring their horns. Since going live more than a week ago, users have already registered 679 complaints against 491 buses across Keralam. The web app, developed using AI tools, began as Bengaluru-based Hrishikesh Vinod’s way of venting about a private bus that rear-ended his brand-new car in April this year. When Hrishikesh, who runs a marketing agency, bought a new car, he wanted to show it to his mother at Kappad, in Kannur, Keralam. “I brought it to Kannur, and within three days the incident happened. This was my way of venting. I did it for myself; I didn't intend to make it public. But what happened to Akshara S, who was run over by a private bus in Kochi on November 4, and what her husband, Varun, posted on social media about losing her struck a chord. A spate of other incidents involving private buses also prompted me to throw the app open to the public,” says Hrishikesh. Hrishikesh Vinod, who developed the Idi Vandi web app | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT He clarifies that he doesn't mean to malign bus drivers or owners, but to demand accountability. “This is not designed to hassle or get them into trouble; I want them to spare some thought for their behaviour and how they treat others using the roads.” Idi vandi is colloquial for rashly driven buses, which cause accidents. All complaints and incidents are verified using AI. “I have set up several firewalls so that people do not use this website as a platform to settle personal scores.” For instance, a person cannot make more than two complaints a day. There are more than 20 criteria for complaints, including racing, rash driving, honking, harassing passengers, and dangerous overtaking. Each offence comes with a score or ‘idi points’: rear-ending gets five points, causing an accident gets a score of six, a bus that causes a fatality gains 10 points, and so on. There is even a leaderboard of buses with the most violations. Apart from complaining on the website, which will be forwarded after mandatory vetting to the concerned Road Transport Office (RTO), there is also the option of making a direct complaint. This will be anonymous; only idivandi.com and the Motor Vehicle Department (MVD) will have access to the complainant’s details. So far, Idi Vandi has sent 15 complaints to RTOs across Keralam. The offices have received only three responses. “If a bus racks up more than three complaints, an email is sent to the RTO, with a reminder every 30 days.” Since he has just gone live, he is considering options about what to do if there is no response. An option he is considering is filing an RTI application, asking what action has been taken, if the two follow-up requests are ignored.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Think about it… there would be 2000-odd private buses plying on our roads along various routes. If there are complaints against 400-plus of these, it is a huge number of violations!” It is not all errant buses on Idi Vandi; a Nalla Vandi section lists buses that have been ‘good ’, like helping passengers and showing kindness to students and the disabled.

articles.title: Buzz at Cyberabad Moves 2026 as citizens, experts discuss mobility challenges and solutions
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: An exhibition at the event highlighted congestion-prone areas and gaps in public transport accessibility, making urban mobility challenges easier to understand through visual and interactive experiences

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A buzzing atmosphere, interactive displays, enthusiastic student participation and discussions on the future of urban transport marked the opening of Cyberabad Moves 2026 at T-Hub in Raidurgam, Hyderabad , on Thursday (November 26, 2026). The three-day initiative, aimed at addressing traffic congestion and promoting sustainable urban mobility, brought together police officials, students, global mobility experts, industry representatives and public officials for an engaging and immersive experience. Director General of Police C.V. Anand inaugurated the event in the presence of Cyberabad Police Commissioner M. Ramesh and Serilingampally MLA Arekapudi Gandhi. Organised by the Cyberabad Municipal Corporation, Cyberabad Police and the Society for Cyberabad Security Council (SCSC), in partnership with the SHIFT Transport coalition, the event will continue until November 28. Telangana DGP C.V. Anand inaugurated Cyberabad Moves 2026 summit at T-Hub in Raidurgam on Thursday (November 26, 2026) | Photo Credit: Handle @CMC_Offcl on X The venue featured maps of Cyberabad, interactive displays and data visualisations, allowing visitors to explore how their everyday journeys connect with the wider network of roads, buses, metro rail services and footpaths. The exhibition also highlighted congestion-prone areas and gaps in public transport accessibility, making urban mobility challenges easier to understand through visual and interactive experiences. Explaining the initiative’s emphasis on shared commuting, the Cyberabad Poliice Commissioner said the pledge for Cyberabad was, “Say hello, hi bolo, no solo, saath chalo.” He said the idea was to discourage people from travelling alone in their vehicles and encourage shared commuting. “During the last 30 to 45 days of preparation, we invited citizens, students and people from all walks of life to share their thoughts and ideas. We received around 2,000 registrations for the event, have 174 volunteers, 120 academic partners and 113 partner organisations,” he said. The initiative aims to promote safer roads, sustainable commuting and better public transport connectivity through collaboration between government agencies, corporates, educational institutions and citizens. The first day’s programme featured addresses by international mobility experts, including Shashi Verma, Chief Technology Officer of Transport for London, and Enrique Peñalosa, former Mayor of Bogotá, Colombia. Mr. Peñalosa highlighted the importance of prioritising public transport and having a clear vision for the kind of cities people want to build. “One bus lane moves up to 80 times more people than a car lane. I cannot make any recommendations about transport unless we know what kind of city we want, whether we want a city like Houston, Miami or Amsterdam. Even before that, we must know how we want to live, because a city is only a means to a way of life,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A key highlight was the launch of mobility best-practice initiatives and the Corporate Commute and Sustainability Pledge, which seeks to encourage organisations and their employees to adopt sustainable commuting practices.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Buzz at Cyberabad Moves 2026 as citizens, experts discuss mobility challenges and solutions

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 03:29:35 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: An exhibition at the event highlighted congestion-prone areas and gaps in public transport accessibility, making urban mobility challenges easier to understand through visual and interactive experiences

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A buzzing atmosphere, interactive displays, enthusiastic student participation and discussions on the future of urban transport marked the opening of Cyberabad Moves 2026 at T-Hub in Raidurgam, Hyderabad , on Thursday (November 26, 2026). The three-day initiative, aimed at addressing traffic congestion and promoting sustainable urban mobility, brought together police officials, students, global mobility experts, industry representatives and public officials for an engaging and immersive experience. Director General of Police C.V. Anand inaugurated the event in the presence of Cyberabad Police Commissioner M. Ramesh and Serilingampally MLA Arekapudi Gandhi. Organised by the Cyberabad Municipal Corporation, Cyberabad Police and the Society for Cyberabad Security Council (SCSC), in partnership with the SHIFT Transport coalition, the event will continue until November 28. Telangana DGP C.V. Anand inaugurated Cyberabad Moves 2026 summit at T-Hub in Raidurgam on Thursday (November 26, 2026) | Photo Credit: Handle @CMC_Offcl on X The venue featured maps of Cyberabad, interactive displays and data visualisations, allowing visitors to explore how their everyday journeys connect with the wider network of roads, buses, metro rail services and footpaths. The exhibition also highlighted congestion-prone areas and gaps in public transport accessibility, making urban mobility challenges easier to understand through visual and interactive experiences. Explaining the initiative’s emphasis on shared commuting, the Cyberabad Poliice Commissioner said the pledge for Cyberabad was, “Say hello, hi bolo, no solo, saath chalo.” He said the idea was to discourage people from travelling alone in their vehicles and encourage shared commuting. “During the last 30 to 45 days of preparation, we invited citizens, students and people from all walks of life to share their thoughts and ideas. We received around 2,000 registrations for the event, have 174 volunteers, 120 academic partners and 113 partner organisations,” he said. The initiative aims to promote safer roads, sustainable commuting and better public transport connectivity through collaboration between government agencies, corporates, educational institutions and citizens. The first day’s programme featured addresses by international mobility experts, including Shashi Verma, Chief Technology Officer of Transport for London, and Enrique Peñalosa, former Mayor of Bogotá, Colombia. Mr. Peñalosa highlighted the importance of prioritising public transport and having a clear vision for the kind of cities people want to build. “One bus lane moves up to 80 times more people than a car lane. I cannot make any recommendations about transport unless we know what kind of city we want, whether we want a city like Houston, Miami or Amsterdam. Even before that, we must know how we want to live, because a city is only a means to a way of life,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A key highlight was the launch of mobility best-practice initiatives and the Corporate Commute and Sustainability Pledge, which seeks to encourage organisations and their employees to adopt sustainable commuting practices.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Accessibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Accessibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Participation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Participation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Buzz at Cyberabad Moves 2026 as citizens, experts discuss mobility challenges and solutions", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. An exhibition at the event highlighted congestion-prone areas and gaps in public transport accessibility, making urban mobility challenges easier to...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Buzz at Cyberabad Moves 2026 as citizens, expert' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Buzz at Cyberabad Moves 2026 as citizens, exp' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Buzz at Cyberabad Moves 2026 as citizens, exp' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "An exhibition at the event highlighted congestion-prone areas and gaps in public transport accessibility, making urban mobility challenges easier to..." (Hinglish Arth: कार्यक्रम में एक प्रदर्शनी में भीड़-भाड़ वाले क्षेत्रों और सार्वजनिक परिवहन पहुंच में अंतराल पर प्रकाश डाला गया, जिससे शहरी गतिशीलता चुनौतियों को दृश्य और इंटरैक्टिव अनुभवों के माध्यम से समझना आसान हो गया।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Buzz at Cyberabad Moves 2026 as citizens, experts discuss mobility challenges and solutions"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. A key highlight was the launch of mobility best-practice initiatives and the Corporate Commute and Sustainability Pledge, which seeks to encourage...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "A key highlight was the launch of mobility best-practice initiatives and the Corporate Commute and Sustainability Pledge, which seeks to encourage..." (Hinglish Arth: एक मुख्य आकर्षण गतिशीलता सर्वोत्तम अभ्यास पहल और कॉर्पोरेट आवागमन और स्थिरता प्रतिज्ञा का शुभारंभ था, जो संगठनों और उनके कर्मचारियों को टिकाऊ आवागमन अभ्यास अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करना चाहता है।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: “India’s Constitution is not just a book; it is the soul of the nation. It is a shield for every citizen’s dignity, the strength of every voice, a guardian of justice, liberty, equality and fraternity,” Rahul Gandhi said, further calling it “our greatest weapon against injustice”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said the people of Uttar Pradesh had taught the BJP a lesson in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, forcing Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s ‘400 paar’ slogan into silence. articles.title: India-Nepal weekly train: Check stations, timings and more about Ayodhya-Janakpur Saryu-Kamala Express
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Ayodhya Cantt-Janakpur Dham Saryu-Kamala Express will have 10 stations, scheduled for departure every Monday. Check out for further details on stations and timings

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In a bid to boost connectivity and bilateral ties with Nepal, the Ministry of Railways has launched Ayodhya Cantt-Janakpur Dham weekly express . Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his Nepalese counterpart Balendra Shah virtually flagged off the Saryu-Kamala Express, connecting Ayodhya in Uttar Pradesh to Janakpur in Nepal, from Delhi on Monday (November 23, 2026). The weekly train will establish a crucial rail link between two pilgrimage sites, namely Janakpur Dham and Ayodhya, believed to be the birthplace of Sita and Ram. Further, the initiative is expected to enhance trade and cultural ties between both countries. The train will cover a distance of approximately 604 kilometres in 19 hours, passing through several important towns in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh . The weekly train will commence its journey from Janakpur Dham on Saturday, and from Ayodhya Cantt on Monday. The express train will commence regular service from November 28. The originating train (15596) from India is scheduled to depart from its station at Ayodhya Cantt. at 5:50 p.m every Monday, and reach the final destination at Janakpur at 12:40 p.m. (Nepali time) next day. On its return journey, the train will leave Janakpur Dham at 1.10 pm (Nepali time) every Saturday and reach Ayodhya Cantt at 8.10 am on Sundays. The train is scheduled to halt at 10 stations as part of its itinerary. Here is the list of stations where the train will have stoppages besides its terminal stations. The Saryu-Kamala Express will be operated using modern 17-coach LHB (Linke Hofmann Busch) rakes. The train configuration includes eight air-conditioned coaches, seven sleeper-class coaches, one LSLRD (LHB Second Class, Luggage, Brake, and Disabled-friendly) coach, and one LWLRRM (LHB Power Car/Generator-cum-Luggage-cum-Brake Van) coach. As per the IRCTC website, the weekly express train service offers four categories of reservation for ticket booking: Sleeper, AC 3 Economy, AC 3 Tier and AC 2 Tier. Passengers can book tickets online or at railway reservation counters. The one-way Sleeper ticket from Ayodhya Cantt to Janakpur Dham costs ₹365. The fares for AC 3 Economy, AC 3 Tier and AC 2 Tier have been fixed at ₹885, ₹965 and ₹1,360, respectively. Indian citizens going to Nepal don’t need a visa if they have a valid passport. Train services from India are conducted to neighbouring countries of Bangladesh and Nepal.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India / Nepal / travel and commuting / railway / Bihar / Uttar Pradesh

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 India-Nepal weekly train: Check stations, timings and more about Ayodhya-Janakpur Saryu-Kamala Express

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 03:28:40 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Ayodhya Cantt-Janakpur Dham Saryu-Kamala Express will have 10 stations, scheduled for departure every Monday. Check out for further details on stations and timings

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In a bid to boost connectivity and bilateral ties with Nepal, the Ministry of Railways has launched Ayodhya Cantt-Janakpur Dham weekly express . Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his Nepalese counterpart Balendra Shah virtually flagged off the Saryu-Kamala Express, connecting Ayodhya in Uttar Pradesh to Janakpur in Nepal, from Delhi on Monday (November 23, 2026). The weekly train will establish a crucial rail link between two pilgrimage sites, namely Janakpur Dham and Ayodhya, believed to be the birthplace of Sita and Ram. Further, the initiative is expected to enhance trade and cultural ties between both countries. The train will cover a distance of approximately 604 kilometres in 19 hours, passing through several important towns in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh . The weekly train will commence its journey from Janakpur Dham on Saturday, and from Ayodhya Cantt on Monday. The express train will commence regular service from November 28. The originating train (15596) from India is scheduled to depart from its station at Ayodhya Cantt. at 5:50 p.m every Monday, and reach the final destination at Janakpur at 12:40 p.m. (Nepali time) next day. On its return journey, the train will leave Janakpur Dham at 1.10 pm (Nepali time) every Saturday and reach Ayodhya Cantt at 8.10 am on Sundays. The train is scheduled to halt at 10 stations as part of its itinerary. Here is the list of stations where the train will have stoppages besides its terminal stations. The Saryu-Kamala Express will be operated using modern 17-coach LHB (Linke Hofmann Busch) rakes. The train configuration includes eight air-conditioned coaches, seven sleeper-class coaches, one LSLRD (LHB Second Class, Luggage, Brake, and Disabled-friendly) coach, and one LWLRRM (LHB Power Car/Generator-cum-Luggage-cum-Brake Van) coach. As per the IRCTC website, the weekly express train service offers four categories of reservation for ticket booking: Sleeper, AC 3 Economy, AC 3 Tier and AC 2 Tier. Passengers can book tickets online or at railway reservation counters. The one-way Sleeper ticket from Ayodhya Cantt to Janakpur Dham costs ₹365. The fares for AC 3 Economy, AC 3 Tier and AC 2 Tier have been fixed at ₹885, ₹965 and ₹1,360, respectively. Indian citizens going to Nepal don’t need a visa if they have a valid passport. Train services from India are conducted to neighbouring countries of Bangladesh and Nepal.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India / Nepal / travel and commuting / railway / Bihar / Uttar Pradesh

द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Configuration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Connectivity (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Connectivity' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Destination (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Destination' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "India-Nepal weekly train: Check stations, timings and more about Ayodhya-Janakpur Saryu-Kamala Express", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Ayodhya Cantt-Janakpur Dham Saryu-Kamala Express will have 10 stations, scheduled for departure every Monday.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'India-Nepal weekly train: Check stations, timing' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'India-Nepal weekly train: Check stations, tim' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'India-Nepal weekly train: Check stations, tim' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Ayodhya Cantt-Janakpur Dham Saryu-Kamala Express will have 10 stations, scheduled for departure every Monday." (Hinglish Arth: प्रत्येक सोमवार को प्रस्थान के लिए निर्धारित अयोध्या कैंट-जनकपुर धाम सरयू-कमला एक्सप्रेस में 10 स्टेशन होंगे।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "India-Nepal weekly train: Check stations, timings and more about Ayodhya-Janakpur Saryu-Kamala Express"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. India / Nepal / travel and commuting / railway / Bihar / Uttar Pradesh.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "India / Nepal / travel and commuting / railway / Bihar / Uttar Pradesh." (Hinglish Arth: भारत/नेपाल/यात्रा एवं आवागमन/रेलवे/बिहार/उत्तर प्रदेश)

articles.title: Drought affects groundnut cultivation in Karnataka; prices rise amid supply shortage
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: According to Agriculture Department data, groundnut sowing this year stood at 1.59 lakh hectares against the target of 2.54 lakh hectares. Of the area sown, crop failure has been recorded across 1.49 lakh hectares, accounting for 93.71% of the total sown area

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: As Bengaluru gears up for the historic Kadlekai Parishe, celebrated in Basavanagudi and Malleshwaram, the arrival of groundnuts in Karnataka’s markets has been delayed this year due to drought conditions, with farmers reporting reduced sowing and poor yields across major groundnut-growing districts. Groundnut farmers in Kolar, Chitradurga, Dharwad, Haveri, Mandya, Mysuru and Tumakuru districts said sowing had declined this year due to inadequate rainfall and drying borewells. Groundnut is predominantly cultivated during the kharif season in these districts, while Vijayapura, Yadgir, Kalaburagi and Raichur districts also cultivate the crop during the summer season. According to data from the Department of Agriculture, groundnut sowing this year stood at 1.59 lakh hectares against the target of 2.54 lakh hectares. Of the area sown, crop failure has been recorded across 1.49 lakh hectares, accounting for 93.71% of the total sown area. Agriculture Department officials attributed the extensive crop failure primarily to deficient rainfall, pointing out that groundnut cultivation in Karnataka is largely rain-dependent. Of the 2.54 lakh hectares targeted for cultivation, around 2.38 lakh hectares are rainfed, while only approximately 0.17 lakh hectares are under irrigation. Although groundnut is not widely cultivated during the rabi season, the department’s data showed that sowing had been completed across 0.58 lakh hectares as of November 13, against a target of 1.33 lakh hectares. Speaking to The Hindu , a senior Agriculture Department official said that the farmers who cultivate groundnut during the rabi season generally have access to better irrigation facilities. “Farmers who cultivate during the rabi season have good water facilities through borewells, or their fields are usually located in command areas,” the official said. Pointing to the delayed market arrivals, K.P. Bhoothaiah, senior vice-president of the Karnataka Rajya Raitha Sangha, Chitradurga, said even farmers who had managed to cultivate groundnut were reporting poor yields. “Even where farmers have cultivated groundnut, the yield is low and the seeds are smaller in size,” he said. Abhilash Reddy, a farmer from Kolar district, said that he had not cultivated groundnut this year due to drought, drying borewells and a shortage of agricultural labourers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Groundnut cultivation is labour-intensive. The crop has to be harvested, dried under the sun and shelled. With the borewells drying up and labour becoming difficult to find, I decided not to cultivate it this year,” he said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Drought affects groundnut cultivation in Karnataka; prices rise amid supply shortage

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 03:18:31 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: According to Agriculture Department data, groundnut sowing this year stood at 1.59 lakh hectares against the target of 2.54 lakh hectares. Of the area sown, crop failure has been recorded across 1.49 lakh hectares, accounting for 93.71% of the total sown area

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: As Bengaluru gears up for the historic Kadlekai Parishe, celebrated in Basavanagudi and Malleshwaram, the arrival of groundnuts in Karnataka’s markets has been delayed this year due to drought conditions, with farmers reporting reduced sowing and poor yields across major groundnut-growing districts. Groundnut farmers in Kolar, Chitradurga, Dharwad, Haveri, Mandya, Mysuru and Tumakuru districts said sowing had declined this year due to inadequate rainfall and drying borewells. Groundnut is predominantly cultivated during the kharif season in these districts, while Vijayapura, Yadgir, Kalaburagi and Raichur districts also cultivate the crop during the summer season. According to data from the Department of Agriculture, groundnut sowing this year stood at 1.59 lakh hectares against the target of 2.54 lakh hectares. Of the area sown, crop failure has been recorded across 1.49 lakh hectares, accounting for 93.71% of the total sown area. Agriculture Department officials attributed the extensive crop failure primarily to deficient rainfall, pointing out that groundnut cultivation in Karnataka is largely rain-dependent. Of the 2.54 lakh hectares targeted for cultivation, around 2.38 lakh hectares are rainfed, while only approximately 0.17 lakh hectares are under irrigation. Although groundnut is not widely cultivated during the rabi season, the department’s data showed that sowing had been completed across 0.58 lakh hectares as of November 13, against a target of 1.33 lakh hectares. Speaking to The Hindu , a senior Agriculture Department official said that the farmers who cultivate groundnut during the rabi season generally have access to better irrigation facilities. “Farmers who cultivate during the rabi season have good water facilities through borewells, or their fields are usually located in command areas,” the official said. Pointing to the delayed market arrivals, K.P. Bhoothaiah, senior vice-president of the Karnataka Rajya Raitha Sangha, Chitradurga, said even farmers who had managed to cultivate groundnut were reporting poor yields. “Even where farmers have cultivated groundnut, the yield is low and the seeds are smaller in size,” he said. Abhilash Reddy, a farmer from Kolar district, said that he had not cultivated groundnut this year due to drought, drying borewells and a shortage of agricultural labourers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Groundnut cultivation is labour-intensive. The crop has to be harvested, dried under the sun and shelled. With the borewells drying up and labour becoming difficult to find, I decided not to cultivate it this year,” he said.
