hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सर्वम की टोकन फैक्ट्री क्या है?।

hinglishTracks.en: What does it mean for India’s AI ambitions?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — भारत की AI महत्वाकांक्षाओं के लिए इसका क्या मतलब है?।

hinglishTracks.en: The story so far: Sarvam AI has so far been known for developing its own Artificial Intelligence (AI) models with support from the government’s IndiaAI Mission .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — अब तक की कहानी: सर्वम एआई अब तक सरकार के इंडियाएआई मिशन के समर्थन से अपने स्वयं के आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (एआई) मॉडल विकसित करने के लिए जाना जाता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Intelligence' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बुद्धिमत्ता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intelligence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: On November 16, the Bengaluru-based startup added another part to its business with the launch of Token Factory, a commercial service that gives businesses access to its own models and those developed by other companies, including Chinese firms.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 16 नवंबर को, बेंगलुरु स्थित स्टार्टअप ने टोकन फैक्ट्री के लॉन्च के साथ अपने व्यवसाय में एक और हिस्सा जोड़ा, एक वाणिज्यिक सेवा जो व्यवसायों को अपने स्वयं के मॉडल और चीनी कंपनियों सहित अन्य कंपनियों द्वारा विकसित मॉडल तक पहुंच प्रदान करती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The launch prompted a debate over whether offering Chinese-developed models through a commercial platform aligns with India’s ambition to build indigenous AI capabilities, particularly when a company has received government support.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — लॉन्च ने इस बात पर बहस छेड़ दी कि क्या वाणिज्यिक मंच के माध्यम से चीनी-विकसित मॉडल पेश करना स्वदेशी एआई क्षमताओं के निर्माण की भारत की महत्वाकांक्षा के अनुरूप है, खासकर जब किसी कंपनी को सरकारी समर्थन प्राप्त हुआ हो।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Indigenous' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया। इसके Synonyms हैं: Domestic, Home-grown, Native और Antonyms हैं: Imported, Foreign, Exotic।

hinglishTracks.en: Hemant Mohapatra, partner at Lightspeed India and an investor in Sarvam, defended the commercial rationale.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लाइटस्पीड इंडिया के पार्टनर और सर्वम में निवेशक, हेमंत महापात्र ने वाणिज्यिक तर्क का बचाव किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: In a November 18 post on X, he said global AI companies were generating substantial revenue by hosting models, including Chinese ones, on infrastructure in India and serving customers worldwide.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — एक्स पर 18 नवंबर की एक पोस्ट में, उन्होंने कहा कि वैश्विक एआई कंपनियां भारत में बुनियादी ढांचे पर चीनी समेत मॉडल की मेजबानी करके और दुनिया भर में ग्राहकों की सेवा करके पर्याप्त राजस्व उत्पन्न कर रही थीं।।

hinglishTracks.en: He attributed the opportunity to a global shortage of GPUs, which has made computing capacity in India attractive to companies seeking to run their models.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उन्होंने इस अवसर के लिए जीपीयू की वैश्विक कमी को जिम्मेदार ठहराया, जिसने भारत में कंप्यूटिंग क्षमता को अपने मॉडल चलाने की इच्छुक कंपनियों के लिए आकर्षक बना दिया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: On November 22, Sarvam co-founder Pratyush Kumar issued a clarification on X, addressing questions about the company’s government support, its decision to host foreign-developed models and its commitment to developing its own models.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 22 नवंबर को, सर्वम के सह-संस्थापक प्रत्यूष कुमार ने एक्स पर एक स्पष्टीकरण जारी किया, जिसमें कंपनी के सरकारी समर्थन, विदेशी-विकसित मॉडलों की मेजबानी करने के निर्णय और अपने स्वयं के मॉडल विकसित करने की प्रतिबद्धता के बारे में सवालों को संबोधित किया गया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Clarification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: स्पष्टीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Clarification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: He said Sarvam had used subsidised computing access under the IndiaAI Mission to train its 105B model, while maintaining that its inference business did not conflict with its objective of developing its own models.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने कहा कि सर्वम ने अपने 105बी मॉडल को प्रशिक्षित करने के लिए इंडियाएआई मिशन के तहत सब्सिडी वाले कंप्यूटिंग एक्सेस का उपयोग किया था, जबकि यह सुनिश्चित करते हुए कि इसका अनुमान व्यवसाय अपने स्वयं के मॉडल विकसित करने के उद्देश्य से संघर्ष नहीं करता था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The government has also defended Sarvam’s commercial strategy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सरकार ने सर्वम की व्यावसायिक रणनीति का भी बचाव किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: IT Secretary S Krishnan told reporters that the Centre did not see any misuse of IndiaAI Mission support in the company’s decision to offer foreign-developed models through Token Factory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — आईटी सचिव एस कृष्णन ने संवाददाताओं से कहा कि केंद्र ने टोकन फैक्ट्री के माध्यम से विदेशी-विकसित मॉडल पेश करने के कंपनी के फैसले में इंडियाएआई मिशन समर्थन का कोई दुरुपयोग नहीं देखा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Based on what Sarvam has told us, based on the experience that people have, we do not see any misuse of the support, which the IndiaAI Mission has provided to Sarvam in the service that they are now offering,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — “सर्वम ने हमें जो बताया है, उसके आधार पर, लोगों के अनुभव के आधार पर, हमें उस समर्थन का कोई दुरुपयोग नहीं दिखता है, जो इंडियाएआई मिशन ने सर्वम को उस सेवा में प्रदान किया है जो वे अब पेश कर रहे हैं,” उन्होंने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Krishnan said there was no contradiction between developing indigenous models and offering foreign-developed ones commercially, adding that AI companies also needed a revenue model.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — कृष्णन ने कहा कि स्वदेशी मॉडल विकसित करने और विदेशी रूप से विकसित मॉडलों को व्यावसायिक रूप से पेश करने के बीच कोई विरोधाभास नहीं है, उन्होंने कहा कि एआई कंपनियों को भी एक राजस्व मॉडल की आवश्यकता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Indigenous' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया। इसके Synonyms हैं: Domestic, Home-grown, Native और Antonyms हैं: Imported, Foreign, Exotic।

hinglishTracks.en: Token Factory is an inference platform that allows developers and businesses to access several AI models through a single Application Programming Interface (API).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — टोकन फ़ैक्टरी एक अनुमान प्लेटफ़ॉर्म है जो डेवलपर्स और व्यवसायों को एक ही एप्लिकेशन प्रोग्रामिंग इंटरफ़ेस (एपीआई) के माध्यम से कई एआई मॉडल तक पहुंचने की अनुमति देता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: An API allows one software application to communicate with another.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एक एपीआई एक सॉफ्टवेयर एप्लिकेशन को दूसरे के साथ संचार करने की अनुमति देता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Instead of setting up and managing the infrastructure needed to run a model, a business can connect its software to Sarvam’s API and send requests to the model it wants to use.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — किसी मॉडल को चलाने के लिए आवश्यक बुनियादी ढांचे को स्थापित करने और प्रबंधित करने के बजाय, कोई व्यवसाय अपने सॉफ़्टवेयर को सर्वम के एपीआई से जोड़ सकता है और उस मॉडल को अनुरोध भेज सकता है जिसका वह उपयोग करना चाहता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The platform offers Sarvam’s 105-billion-parameter model, alongside open-weight models such as GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash from China’s Z.ai, DeepSeek V4 models from DeepSeek, Kimi models from Moonshot AI, and Google’s Gemma 4 31B.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — प्लेटफ़ॉर्म सर्वम के 105-बिलियन-पैरामीटर मॉडल के साथ-साथ चीन के Z.ai से GLM 5.3 और GLM 5.3 फ़्लैश, डीपसीक से डीपसीक V4 मॉडल, मूनशॉट एआई से किमी मॉडल और Google के जेम्मा 4 31B जैसे ओपन-वेट मॉडल पेश करता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Open-weight models are those whose trained parameters, or weights, are made available for others to download and run.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ओपन-वेट मॉडल वे होते हैं जिनके प्रशिक्षित पैरामीटर, या वज़न, दूसरों को डाउनलोड करने और चलाने के लिए उपलब्ध कराए जाते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Businesses can use them without having to develop the models from scratch.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — व्यवसाय शुरू से ही मॉडल विकसित किए बिना उनका उपयोग कर सकते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Sarvam says Token Factory runs the models on GPU clusters located in India.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सर्वम का कहना है कि टोकन फैक्ट्री भारत में स्थित जीपीयू क्लस्टर पर मॉडल चलाती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Customers pay according to the number of tokens processed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ग्राहक संसाधित टोकन की संख्या के अनुसार भुगतान करते हैं।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Training vs inference: What’s the distinction at the heart of the Sarvam AI-China models controversy? | Explained

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 08:58:24 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Can India build an indigenous AI ecosystem while hosting models developed in China? What is Sarvam’s Token Factory? What does it mean for India’s AI ambitions?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Sarvam AI has so far been known for developing its own Artificial Intelligence (AI) models with support from the government’s IndiaAI Mission . On November 16, the Bengaluru-based startup added another part to its business with the launch of Token Factory, a commercial service that gives businesses access to its own models and those developed by other companies, including Chinese firms. The launch prompted a debate over whether offering Chinese-developed models through a commercial platform aligns with India’s ambition to build indigenous AI capabilities, particularly when a company has received government support. Hemant Mohapatra, partner at Lightspeed India and an investor in Sarvam, defended the commercial rationale. In a November 18 post on X, he said global AI companies were generating substantial revenue by hosting models, including Chinese ones, on infrastructure in India and serving customers worldwide. He attributed the opportunity to a global shortage of GPUs, which has made computing capacity in India attractive to companies seeking to run their models. On November 22, Sarvam co-founder Pratyush Kumar issued a clarification on X, addressing questions about the company’s government support, its decision to host foreign-developed models and its commitment to developing its own models. He said Sarvam had used subsidised computing access under the IndiaAI Mission to train its 105B model, while maintaining that its inference business did not conflict with its objective of developing its own models. The government has also defended Sarvam’s commercial strategy. IT Secretary S Krishnan told reporters that the Centre did not see any misuse of IndiaAI Mission support in the company’s decision to offer foreign-developed models through Token Factory. “Based on what Sarvam has told us, based on the experience that people have, we do not see any misuse of the support, which the IndiaAI Mission has provided to Sarvam in the service that they are now offering,” he said. Krishnan said there was no contradiction between developing indigenous models and offering foreign-developed ones commercially, adding that AI companies also needed a revenue model. Token Factory is an inference platform that allows developers and businesses to access several AI models through a single Application Programming Interface (API). An API allows one software application to communicate with another. Instead of setting up and managing the infrastructure needed to run a model, a business can connect its software to Sarvam’s API and send requests to the model it wants to use. The platform offers Sarvam’s 105-billion-parameter model, alongside open-weight models such as GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash from China’s Z.ai, DeepSeek V4 models from DeepSeek, Kimi models from Moonshot AI, and Google’s Gemma 4 31B. Open-weight models are those whose trained parameters, or weights, are made available for others to download and run. Businesses can use them without having to develop the models from scratch.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sarvam says Token Factory runs the models on GPU clusters located in India. Customers pay according to the number of tokens processed.

Indigenous (Adjective)
स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया।

Contradiction (Noun)
विरोधाभास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Contradiction' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Can India build an indigenous AI ecosystem while hosting models developed in China? What is Sarvam’s Token Factory? What does it mean for India’s AI ambitions?
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Sarvam AI has so far been known for developing its own Artificial Intelligence (AI) models with support from the government’s IndiaAI Mission . On November 16, the Bengaluru-based startup added another part to its business with the launch of Token Factory, a commercial service that gives businesses access to its own models and those developed by other companies, including Chinese firms. The launch prompted a debate over whether offering Chinese-developed models through a commercial platform aligns with India’s ambition to build indigenous AI capabilities, particularly when a company has received government support. Hemant Mohapatra, partner at Lightspeed India and an investor in Sarvam, defended the commercial rationale. In a November 18 post on X, he said global AI companies were generating substantial revenue by hosting models, including Chinese ones, on infrastructure in India and serving customers worldwide. He attributed the opportunity to a global shortage of GPUs, which has made computing capacity in India attractive to companies seeking to run their models. On November 22, Sarvam co-founder Pratyush Kumar issued a clarification on X, addressing questions about the company’s government support, its decision to host foreign-developed models and its commitment to developing its own models. He said Sarvam had used subsidised computing access under the IndiaAI Mission to train its 105B model, while maintaining that its inference business did not conflict with its objective of developing its own models. The government has also defended Sarvam’s commercial strategy. IT Secretary S Krishnan told reporters that the Centre did not see any misuse of IndiaAI Mission support in the company’s decision to offer foreign-developed models through Token Factory. “Based on what Sarvam has told us, based on the experience that people have, we do not see any misuse of the support, which the IndiaAI Mission has provided to Sarvam in the service that they are now offering,” he said. Krishnan said there was no contradiction between developing indigenous models and offering foreign-developed ones commercially, adding that AI companies also needed a revenue model. Token Factory is an inference platform that allows developers and businesses to access several AI models through a single Application Programming Interface (API). An API allows one software application to communicate with another. Instead of setting up and managing the infrastructure needed to run a model, a business can connect its software to Sarvam’s API and send requests to the model it wants to use. The platform offers Sarvam’s 105-billion-parameter model, alongside open-weight models such as GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash from China’s Z.ai, DeepSeek V4 models from DeepSeek, Kimi models from Moonshot AI, and Google’s Gemma 4 31B. Open-weight models are those whose trained parameters, or weights, are made available for others to download and run. Businesses can use them without having to develop the models from scratch.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sarvam says Token Factory runs the models on GPU clusters located in India. Customers pay according to the number of tokens processed.

articles.title: Sthanika Bhattars make contradictory statements on the lighting of deepam
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: On November 24, the Executive Officer of the Subramaniya Swamy Temple at Thirupparankundram had said the reasoning for lighting the lamp at the Deepa Mandapam was backed by the Bhattars. But a letter purportedly written by the Bhattars, stating that they had not given any letter of consent, went viral on social media the next day

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Sthanika Bhattars of the Subramaniya Swamy Temple at Thirupparankundram gave some tense moments to the Madurai district administration by making contradictory statements on their “consent” for lighting the ceremonial lamp at the traditional spot — Deepa Mandapam — on Karthigai Deepam day. The administration had submitted at the Supreme Court that despite its readiness to light the lamp at the deepathoon , it could not comply with the court directive as the temple’s Board of Trustees insisted on lighting the lamp only at the Deepa Mandapam, following age-old practices, customs and rituals, and agama rules. A statement made on November 24 by the temple’s Executive Officer, G. Selvi, had said the reasoning for lighting the lamp at the Deepa Mandapam was backed by the Bhattars. However, the next day, a letter purportedly written by the Bhattars, stating that they had not given any letter of consent on lighting the lamp on November 24, went viral on social media. They said they had given consent for lighting the lamp at the usual spot near Uchipillaiyar Temple “last year” (2025). The recent statement by the Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department referring to their consent, made “without consulting” them, had caused mental agony, they said. Meanwhile, there was commotion outside the house of Swaminatha Bhattar late in the evening on Wednesday, as functionaries of the BJP and Hindu outfits arrived at the priest’s house. Temple officials too were present at the house. The BJP functionaries said the Bhattars were being “forced” to give a new letter of consent to help the officials substantiate their stand before the Supreme Court. The demonstrators were detained by the police. An official of the Department said the Bhattars gave the new letter on Wednesday to the Board of Trustees. “The lighting of Karthigai Deepam has been done at the Uchipillaiyar Temple since 1996 with the cooperation of the temple authorities,” said the letter, signed by four Bhattars. However, they underlined that they were only replying to a letter written by the temple administration, seeking their opinion on this issue.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: They reasoned that the Utchipillaiyar Temple, the Rajagopuram, and the venue for burning chokkapanai near the 16-Pillar Mandapam lie on a straight line, and the Utchipillaiyar Temple was located right above the sanctum sanctorum. They also confirmed that they had given the same opinion “in writing” on November 7, 2013 and December 4, 2025. “The deepam is lit at the deepamandapam after getting oral or written opinion from us every year. This is in line with the agama rules and age-old Saiva customs,” they clarified.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Sthanika Bhattars make contradictory statements on the lighting of deepam

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 11:30:13 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: On November 24, the Executive Officer of the Subramaniya Swamy Temple at Thirupparankundram had said the reasoning for lighting the lamp at the Deepa Mandapam was backed by the Bhattars. But a letter purportedly written by the Bhattars, stating that they had not given any letter of consent, went viral on social media the next day

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Sthanika Bhattars of the Subramaniya Swamy Temple at Thirupparankundram gave some tense moments to the Madurai district administration by making contradictory statements on their “consent” for lighting the ceremonial lamp at the traditional spot — Deepa Mandapam — on Karthigai Deepam day. The administration had submitted at the Supreme Court that despite its readiness to light the lamp at the deepathoon , it could not comply with the court directive as the temple’s Board of Trustees insisted on lighting the lamp only at the Deepa Mandapam, following age-old practices, customs and rituals, and agama rules. A statement made on November 24 by the temple’s Executive Officer, G. Selvi, had said the reasoning for lighting the lamp at the Deepa Mandapam was backed by the Bhattars. However, the next day, a letter purportedly written by the Bhattars, stating that they had not given any letter of consent on lighting the lamp on November 24, went viral on social media. They said they had given consent for lighting the lamp at the usual spot near Uchipillaiyar Temple “last year” (2025). The recent statement by the Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department referring to their consent, made “without consulting” them, had caused mental agony, they said. Meanwhile, there was commotion outside the house of Swaminatha Bhattar late in the evening on Wednesday, as functionaries of the BJP and Hindu outfits arrived at the priest’s house. Temple officials too were present at the house. The BJP functionaries said the Bhattars were being “forced” to give a new letter of consent to help the officials substantiate their stand before the Supreme Court. The demonstrators were detained by the police. An official of the Department said the Bhattars gave the new letter on Wednesday to the Board of Trustees. “The lighting of Karthigai Deepam has been done at the Uchipillaiyar Temple since 1996 with the cooperation of the temple authorities,” said the letter, signed by four Bhattars. However, they underlined that they were only replying to a letter written by the temple administration, seeking their opinion on this issue.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: They reasoned that the Utchipillaiyar Temple, the Rajagopuram, and the venue for burning chokkapanai near the 16-Pillar Mandapam lie on a straight line, and the Utchipillaiyar Temple was located right above the sanctum sanctorum. They also confirmed that they had given the same opinion “in writing” on November 7, 2013 and December 4, 2025. “The deepam is lit at the deepamandapam after getting oral or written opinion from us every year. This is in line with the agama rules and age-old Saiva customs,” they clarified.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A total of 803 applications were received during the three-day Revenue Tax Melas organised by the Greater Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporation (GVMC) across its zones from November 24 to 26, Commissioner Ketan Garg said on Thursday.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The civic body received 93 applications on the first day, 394 on the second and 316 on the third. Among the zones, the North Zone recorded the highest number of submissions at 159, followed by Madhurawada 103 and East Zone with 97. Aganampudi recorded the lowest, at 27. According to Mr. Garg, requests for change of ownership accounted for the largest share with 229 applications, followed by 168 general revision petitions and 142 applications for new assessments. The corporation also received 87 applications for correction of house numbers, 38 for correction of owners’ names and 94 concerning other issues. The remaining applications were related to demolitions, assessment modifications, bifurcations, property tax exemptions and mergers.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Garg directed officials to scrutinise all applications and resolve the grievances promptly.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In a relief for electricity consumers amid rising household expenses, electricity supply companies (Escoms) across Karnataka are likely to pass on their profits to consumers in the form of a refund of around 16 paise per unit from April 2027.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Sources in the Energy Department said on Thursday that most Escoms, including Bangalore Electricity Supply Company (Bescom), Gulbarga Electricity Supply Company (Gescom), Chamundeshwari Electricity Supply Corporation (CESC), and Mangalore Electricity Supply Company (Mescom), have recorded profits for the financial year 2025-26. However, Hubli Electricity Supply Company (Hescom) is an exception. A senior Energy Department official said the improved financial performance would enable Escoms to return the gains to consumers. Bescom alone reported a profit of ₹293.62 crore during 2025-26, while the profit figures of other Escoms are yet to be officially announced. Every year, Escoms are required to submit their tariff status and profit-and-loss statements, known as truing-up petitions, to the Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission (KERC) as part of their annual performance review. The companies are scheduled to submit their petitions on November 30. Once the proposals receive KERC’s approval, the refund will be adjusted against electricity bills for consumption from April 2027. While the average refund is expected to be around 16 paise per unit, consumers in some Escom jurisdictions could receive a higher benefit. Bescom sources said the company was seeking a refund of 35 paise per unit, although the proposal is yet to be finalised. The approved amount is expected to be announced on the Bescom website in December 2026.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Officials attributed the improved financial performance to a reduction in power distribution losses from 11% to around 9.13%. Escoms also reduced power procurement costs by utilising more electricity generated through hydropower instead of relying on relatively expensive thermal power.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: In a relief for electricity consumers amid rising household expenses, electricity supply companies (Escoms) across Karnataka are likely to pass on their profits to consumers in the form of a refund of around 16 paise per unit from April 2027.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Sources in the Energy Department said on Thursday that most Escoms, including Bangalore Electricity Supply Company (Bescom), Gulbarga Electricity Supply Company (Gescom), Chamundeshwari Electricity Supply Corporation (CESC), and Mangalore Electricity Supply Company (Mescom), have recorded profits for the financial year 2025-26. However, Hubli Electricity Supply Company (Hescom) is an exception. A senior Energy Department official said the improved financial performance would enable Escoms to return the gains to consumers. Bescom alone reported a profit of ₹293.62 crore during 2025-26, while the profit figures of other Escoms are yet to be officially announced. Every year, Escoms are required to submit their tariff status and profit-and-loss statements, known as truing-up petitions, to the Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission (KERC) as part of their annual performance review. The companies are scheduled to submit their petitions on November 30. Once the proposals receive KERC’s approval, the refund will be adjusted against electricity bills for consumption from April 2027. While the average refund is expected to be around 16 paise per unit, consumers in some Escom jurisdictions could receive a higher benefit. Bescom sources said the company was seeking a refund of 35 paise per unit, although the proposal is yet to be finalised. The approved amount is expected to be announced on the Bescom website in December 2026.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Officials attributed the improved financial performance to a reduction in power distribution losses from 11% to around 9.13%. Escoms also reduced power procurement costs by utilising more electricity generated through hydropower instead of relying on relatively expensive thermal power.

articles.title: Four-member gang targeting cab, bike taxi drivers arrested in Bengaluru
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Gang allegedly committed over 30 robberies in three months to fund drug purchases; police trace 11 cases

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Whitefield police have busted an extortion racket and arrested four men who allegedly targeted cab and bike taxi drivers at night, assaulted them, and extorted money. The gang is suspected of having committed over two dozen such robberies in the past three months to fund their drug addiction and other vices. The accused have been identified as Manoj, Preetham Prakash, Syed Shafi, and Akhilesh, residents of Gandhipura and Vijayanagar in Whitefield. The arrests followed a complaint by Mohammed Nisar, a bike rider, who was allegedly intercepted and assaulted by the accused on an isolated stretch near Nallurhalli Metro station. The accused, who arrived in a car, allegedly assaulted him and forced him to transfer money online from his mobile phone before fleeing. Following the complaint, a team of Whitefield police, led by DCP Haribabu, launched an operation to track down the gang. The police traced the rental aggregator through which the accused had hired the car and followed the vehicle for around 2 km to 3 km. As the accused allegedly drove at high speed to evade the police, the investigators sought the rental company’s assistance in remotely switching off the car’s engine. When the vehicle came to a halt, the accused stepped out to check the engine. Police personnel surrounded the car and arrested three of them on the spot. The fourth accused, who initially managed to escape, was arrested later. The probe revealed that all four accused were drug users and allegedly committed the robberies to raise money to buy narcotics. The money extorted from drivers was reportedly transferred directly to the bank account of a suspected drug peddler. Manoj, the prime accused, allegedly planned the robberies and identified potential targets. Preetham Prakash, a BCom graduate, was his associate, while Syed Shafi worked as a cab driver and Akhilesh was employed as a tattoo artist. The gang initially used an autorickshaw to commit the robberies but later switched to a rented car to target drivers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: During interrogation, the accused allegedly confessed to committing around 30 robberies in three months. The police have so far traced and linked the gang to 11 incidents.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Four-member gang targeting cab, bike taxi drivers arrested in Bengaluru

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 11:20:05 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Gang allegedly committed over 30 robberies in three months to fund drug purchases; police trace 11 cases

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Whitefield police have busted an extortion racket and arrested four men who allegedly targeted cab and bike taxi drivers at night, assaulted them, and extorted money. The gang is suspected of having committed over two dozen such robberies in the past three months to fund their drug addiction and other vices. The accused have been identified as Manoj, Preetham Prakash, Syed Shafi, and Akhilesh, residents of Gandhipura and Vijayanagar in Whitefield. The arrests followed a complaint by Mohammed Nisar, a bike rider, who was allegedly intercepted and assaulted by the accused on an isolated stretch near Nallurhalli Metro station. The accused, who arrived in a car, allegedly assaulted him and forced him to transfer money online from his mobile phone before fleeing. Following the complaint, a team of Whitefield police, led by DCP Haribabu, launched an operation to track down the gang. The police traced the rental aggregator through which the accused had hired the car and followed the vehicle for around 2 km to 3 km. As the accused allegedly drove at high speed to evade the police, the investigators sought the rental company’s assistance in remotely switching off the car’s engine. When the vehicle came to a halt, the accused stepped out to check the engine. Police personnel surrounded the car and arrested three of them on the spot. The fourth accused, who initially managed to escape, was arrested later. The probe revealed that all four accused were drug users and allegedly committed the robberies to raise money to buy narcotics. The money extorted from drivers was reportedly transferred directly to the bank account of a suspected drug peddler. Manoj, the prime accused, allegedly planned the robberies and identified potential targets. Preetham Prakash, a BCom graduate, was his associate, while Syed Shafi worked as a cab driver and Akhilesh was employed as a tattoo artist. The gang initially used an autorickshaw to commit the robberies but later switched to a rented car to target drivers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: During interrogation, the accused allegedly confessed to committing around 30 robberies in three months. The police have so far traced and linked the gang to 11 incidents.

Extortion (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Extortion' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Four-member gang targeting cab, bike taxi drivers arrested in Bengaluru", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Gang allegedly committed over 30 robberies in three months to fund drug purchases; police trace 11 cases.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Four-member gang targeting cab, bike taxi driver' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Four-member gang targeting cab, bike taxi dri' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Four-member gang targeting cab, bike taxi dri' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Gang allegedly committed over 30 robberies in three months to fund drug purchases; police trace 11 cases."
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Four-member gang targeting cab, bike taxi drivers arrested in Bengaluru"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The police have so far traced and linked the gang to 11 incidents.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The police have so far traced and linked the gang to 11 incidents."

articles.title: CPI announces three-day ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’ from December 1
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Demands include CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation, implementation of women’s quota, and legal MSP guarantee for farmers

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Communist Party of India (CPI) general secretary D. Raja on Thursday (November 26, 2026) announced a three-day “Jail Bharo Andolan” from December 1 to 3 on a set of political and economic demands, including the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, implementation of women’s reservation, and a legal guarantee for Minimum Support Price (MSP) for farmers. Addressing a press conference, Mr. Raja said the country was facing multiple crises, claiming that the economy was in a poor state, prices were rising and unemployment remained high. He also expressed concern over “increasing atrocities against minorities, Dalits, women and children.” The CPI leader said Prime Minister Narendra Modi often spoke and wrote about the Constitution but he should be “truthful to the people and the country”. He said the Constitution made it clear that India should remain a secular democratic republic and noted that B.R. Ambedkar had rejected the idea of a theocratic state. Mr. Raja accused Mr. Modi of seeking to establish a “Hindu Rashtra”, which he described as a “unidimensional, monolithic neoliberal medieval social order” that perpetuated caste inequalities and subverted the Constitution. Mr. Raja appealed to “all secular democratic forces” to unite against the BJP and work towards defeating the ruling party in the coming Assembly elections in five States.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He said the CPI had held informal discussions with the Samajwadi Party and the Congress regarding seat-sharing in Uttar Pradesh and Punjab.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 CPI announces three-day ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’ from December 1

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 11:18:52 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Demands include CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation, implementation of women’s quota, and legal MSP guarantee for farmers

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Communist Party of India (CPI) general secretary D. Raja on Thursday (November 26, 2026) announced a three-day “Jail Bharo Andolan” from December 1 to 3 on a set of political and economic demands, including the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, implementation of women’s reservation, and a legal guarantee for Minimum Support Price (MSP) for farmers. Addressing a press conference, Mr. Raja said the country was facing multiple crises, claiming that the economy was in a poor state, prices were rising and unemployment remained high. He also expressed concern over “increasing atrocities against minorities, Dalits, women and children.” The CPI leader said Prime Minister Narendra Modi often spoke and wrote about the Constitution but he should be “truthful to the people and the country”. He said the Constitution made it clear that India should remain a secular democratic republic and noted that B.R. Ambedkar had rejected the idea of a theocratic state. Mr. Raja accused Mr. Modi of seeking to establish a “Hindu Rashtra”, which he described as a “unidimensional, monolithic neoliberal medieval social order” that perpetuated caste inequalities and subverted the Constitution. Mr. Raja appealed to “all secular democratic forces” to unite against the BJP and work towards defeating the ruling party in the coming Assembly elections in five States.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He said the CPI had held informal discussions with the Samajwadi Party and the Congress regarding seat-sharing in Uttar Pradesh and Punjab.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Unemployment (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Unemployment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "CPI announces three-day ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’ from December 1", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Demands include CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation, implementation of women’s quota, and legal MSP guarantee for farmers.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'CPI announces three-day ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’ fro' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'CPI announces three-day ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’ ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'CPI announces three-day ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’ ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Demands include CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation, implementation of women’s quota, and legal MSP guarantee for farmers."
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "CPI announces three-day ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’ from December 1"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. He said the CPI had held informal discussions with the Samajwadi Party and the Congress regarding seat-sharing in Uttar Pradesh and Punjab.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "He said the CPI had held informal discussions with the Samajwadi Party and the Congress regarding seat-sharing in Uttar Pradesh and Punjab."

articles.title: Yemen's Houthi-held capital hit after group targets Riyadh
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The exchanges between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen have become near-daily in the country's revived civil war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Houthi media reported a series of Saudi airstrikes against territory held by the Iran-backed group including the capital Sanaa on Thursday (November 26, 2026), hours after it struck Riyadh. The exchanges between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen have become near-daily in the country's revived civil war, which first began more than a decade ago. The coalition, which backs Yemen's internationally recognised government, said during the night that it had intercepted two ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis towards the Saudi capital of Riyadh, where residents and an AFP journalist heard an explosion. It also said it had destroyed a cruise missile launched towards the west of the country and a drone in the Jeddah region on the Red Sea. "The air force of the Saudi enemy today launched a series of strikes at the capital Sanaa," the Houthis' press agency reported on Thursday morning. An AFP journalist in Sanaa reported seeing smoke in the area of the airport. The Houthi news outlet Almasirah reported that the strikes targeted a factory and warehouses in Bani al-Harith. Later on Thursday (November 26, 2026), residents of the key Houthi-controlled port of Hodeida told AFP they had heard jets flying over the city and loud explosions. Almasirah said the strikes destroyed a wastewater treatment facility serving a densely populated district. The Houthis said the day before they had struck two Saudi ports on the Red Sea, after Saudi strikes on Hodeida.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The coalition, meanwhile, said it had brought down a Houthi projectile targeting Jazan that had caused light damage and no civilian casualties.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Yemen's Houthi-held capital hit after group targets Riyadh

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 11:09:34 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The exchanges between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen have become near-daily in the country's revived civil war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Houthi media reported a series of Saudi airstrikes against territory held by the Iran-backed group including the capital Sanaa on Thursday (November 26, 2026), hours after it struck Riyadh. The exchanges between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen have become near-daily in the country's revived civil war, which first began more than a decade ago. The coalition, which backs Yemen's internationally recognised government, said during the night that it had intercepted two ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis towards the Saudi capital of Riyadh, where residents and an AFP journalist heard an explosion. It also said it had destroyed a cruise missile launched towards the west of the country and a drone in the Jeddah region on the Red Sea. "The air force of the Saudi enemy today launched a series of strikes at the capital Sanaa," the Houthis' press agency reported on Thursday morning. An AFP journalist in Sanaa reported seeing smoke in the area of the airport. The Houthi news outlet Almasirah reported that the strikes targeted a factory and warehouses in Bani al-Harith. Later on Thursday (November 26, 2026), residents of the key Houthi-controlled port of Hodeida told AFP they had heard jets flying over the city and loud explosions. Almasirah said the strikes destroyed a wastewater treatment facility serving a densely populated district. The Houthis said the day before they had struck two Saudi ports on the Red Sea, after Saudi strikes on Hodeida.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The coalition, meanwhile, said it had brought down a Houthi projectile targeting Jazan that had caused light damage and no civilian casualties.

articles.title: Israel kills nine in Gaza, including Hamas-appointed deputy Education Minister, officials say
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Medics said an Israeli airstrike hit an apartment in Deir Al-Balah in central Gaza Strip, killing ‌Khaled Abu Nada, the Deputy Gaza Education Minister, and his wife.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli airstrikes ‌and gunfire killed at least nine Palestinians overnight, medics said, including the ​Hamas-appointed deputy minister of education in the Gaza Strip, in ⁠a third consecutive night of air attacks despite a one-year-old ceasefire. Medics said an Israeli airstrike hit an apartment in Deir Al-Balah in central Gaza Strip on Thursday, killing ‌Khaled Abu Nada, the deputy Gaza education minister, and his wife. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the attack was one of ‌a series of targeted killings carried out recently against members and ‌senior ⁠officials in Hamas, adding that Israel has killed about 80 ⁠Hamas militants in the past month. "No terrorist is immune, and no one in the Hamas leadership will manage to evade us," said Mr. Netanyahu. The Israeli military said Abu Nada oversaw ​Hamas' economic portfolio and managed its ‌banking and investment network, directing funds toward militant activities and force buildup. The military said his death may weaken the group's ability to sustain its finances and support its military capabilities. Hamas confirmed the death but had ‌no immediate comment on the allegations about his role. Two other separate ​airstrikes killed six people in Tuffah neighbourhood and Beach refugee camp overnight in Gaza City, medics added. Later on Thursday (November 26, 2026), ⁠medics said Israeli gunfire killed a 62-year-old man in eastern Bureij refugee camp. The Israeli military didn't immediately comment on those seven reported deaths. Israel has continued to ‌carry out attacks that it says target Hamas but which have also killed many civilians. The broader ceasefire plan, backed by U.S. President Donald Trump, has not halted the violence or secured Hamas' disarmament. Abu Nada was the third senior Hamas official Israel has killed since Tuesday, after two senior security officials.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: At least 1,600 Palestinians and 5 Israeli soldiers have been killed ‌since the ceasefire was agreed in October 2025, according to respective Palestinian and Israeli tallies.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Israel kills nine in Gaza, including Hamas-appointed deputy Education Minister, officials say

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 11:05:25 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Medics said an Israeli airstrike hit an apartment in Deir Al-Balah in central Gaza Strip, killing ‌Khaled Abu Nada, the Deputy Gaza Education Minister, and his wife.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli airstrikes ‌and gunfire killed at least nine Palestinians overnight, medics said, including the ​Hamas-appointed deputy minister of education in the Gaza Strip, in ⁠a third consecutive night of air attacks despite a one-year-old ceasefire. Medics said an Israeli airstrike hit an apartment in Deir Al-Balah in central Gaza Strip on Thursday, killing ‌Khaled Abu Nada, the deputy Gaza education minister, and his wife. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the attack was one of ‌a series of targeted killings carried out recently against members and ‌senior ⁠officials in Hamas, adding that Israel has killed about 80 ⁠Hamas militants in the past month. "No terrorist is immune, and no one in the Hamas leadership will manage to evade us," said Mr. Netanyahu. The Israeli military said Abu Nada oversaw ​Hamas' economic portfolio and managed its ‌banking and investment network, directing funds toward militant activities and force buildup. The military said his death may weaken the group's ability to sustain its finances and support its military capabilities. Hamas confirmed the death but had ‌no immediate comment on the allegations about his role. Two other separate ​airstrikes killed six people in Tuffah neighbourhood and Beach refugee camp overnight in Gaza City, medics added. Later on Thursday (November 26, 2026), ⁠medics said Israeli gunfire killed a 62-year-old man in eastern Bureij refugee camp. The Israeli military didn't immediately comment on those seven reported deaths. Israel has continued to ‌carry out attacks that it says target Hamas but which have also killed many civilians. The broader ceasefire plan, backed by U.S. President Donald Trump, has not halted the violence or secured Hamas' disarmament. Abu Nada was the third senior Hamas official Israel has killed since Tuesday, after two senior security officials.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: At least 1,600 Palestinians and 5 Israeli soldiers have been killed ‌since the ceasefire was agreed in October 2025, according to respective Palestinian and Israeli tallies.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli airstrikes ‌and gunfire killed at least nine Palestinians overnight, medics said, including the ​Hamas-appointed deputy minister of education in the Gaza Strip, in ⁠a third consecutive night of air attacks despite a one-year-old ceasefire. Medics said an Israeli airstrike hit an apartment in Deir Al-Balah in central Gaza Strip on Thursday, killing ‌Khaled Abu Nada, the deputy Gaza education minister, and his wife. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the attack was one of ‌a series of targeted killings carried out recently against members and ‌senior ⁠officials in Hamas, adding that Israel has killed about 80 ⁠Hamas militants in the past month. "No terrorist is immune, and no one in the Hamas leadership will manage to evade us," said Mr. Netanyahu. The Israeli military said Abu Nada oversaw ​Hamas' economic portfolio and managed its ‌banking and investment network, directing funds toward militant activities and force buildup. The military said his death may weaken the group's ability to sustain its finances and support its military capabilities. Hamas confirmed the death but had ‌no immediate comment on the allegations about his role. Two other separate ​airstrikes killed six people in Tuffah neighbourhood and Beach refugee camp overnight in Gaza City, medics added. Later on Thursday (November 26, 2026), ⁠medics said Israeli gunfire killed a 62-year-old man in eastern Bureij refugee camp. The Israeli military didn't immediately comment on those seven reported deaths. Israel has continued to ‌carry out attacks that it says target Hamas but which have also killed many civilians. The broader ceasefire plan, backed by U.S. President Donald Trump, has not halted the violence or secured Hamas' disarmament. Abu Nada was the third senior Hamas official Israel has killed since Tuesday, after two senior security officials.

articles.title: Myanmar says it will not fully comply with ICJ genocide orders
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ruling by ‌the ⁠ICJ, the first instance of the UN court holding a ⁠state responsible for genocide, is final but the court has very limited options to enforce it

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Myanmar's military-backed ‌President has said his administration will not comply with all ​measures ordered by the UN's top court, which last ⁠week ruled that the country's security forces had committed genocide against the Rohingya. The International Court of Justice (ICJ) found that the Myanmar military's actions against the mainly ‌Muslim Rohingya minority in 2017, including thousands of killings, the burning of hundreds of villages and widespread sexual violence, amounted ‌to genocide — and ordered a slew of measures. The ruling by ‌the ⁠ICJ, the first instance of the UN court holding a ⁠state responsible for genocide, is final but the court has very limited options to enforce it. "Myanmar would take actions appropriate for a responsible country but would not comply with requirements it considered inappropriate," he said in a meeting on ‌Wednesday, according to state media. Min Aung Hlaing did not elaborate ​on what court orders his administration considered inappropriate. The ICJ has ordered Myanmar to end ongoing breaches of the Genocide ⁠Convention and promptly investigate, prosecute and punish people reasonably suspected of involvement in the 2017 military operations. It also ordered the country to provide guarantees ‌that such violations will not be repeated. Myanmar must also facilitate the return of displaced Rohingya, restore or replace lost property, help locate missing people, provide rehabilitation to survivors, and protect Rohingya from discrimination and persecution. The court further ordered Myanmar to pay compensation for the harm caused to Rohingya that is not remedied through restitution. Myanmar must report ‌back within two years on the measures it has taken, including proposed compensation, ​the order said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Myanmar has maintained that operations undertaken by its security forces in northern Rakhine state during 2016–2018 ⁠were counter-terrorism actions against an insurgent group.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ⁠आईसीजे का फैसला, संयुक्त राष्ट्र अदालत द्वारा किसी राज्य को नरसंहार के लिए जिम्मेदार ठहराने का पहला उदाहरण, अंतिम है लेकिन अदालत के पास इसे लागू करने के लिए बहुत सीमित विकल्प हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

hinglishTracks.en: "Myanmar would take actions appropriate for a responsible country but would not comply with requirements it considered inappropriate," he said in a meeting on ‌Wednesday, according to state media.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — राज्य मीडिया के अनुसार, बुधवार को एक बैठक में उन्होंने कहा, "म्यांमार एक जिम्मेदार देश के लिए उचित कार्रवाई करेगा, लेकिन अनुचित समझी जाने वाली आवश्यकताओं का पालन नहीं करेगा।"।

hinglishTracks.en: Min Aung Hlaing did not elaborate ​on what court orders his administration considered inappropriate.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मिन आंग ह्लाइंग ने यह नहीं बताया कि उनके प्रशासन ने अदालत के किस आदेश को अनुचित माना है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Administration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The ICJ has ordered Myanmar to end ongoing breaches of the Genocide ⁠Convention and promptly investigate, prosecute and punish people reasonably suspected of involvement in the 2017 military operations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आईसीजे ने म्यांमार को नरसंहार कन्वेंशन के चल रहे उल्लंघनों को समाप्त करने और 2017 के सैन्य अभियानों में शामिल होने के संदिग्ध लोगों की तुरंत जांच करने, मुकदमा चलाने और दंडित करने का आदेश दिया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It also ordered the country to provide guarantees ‌that such violations will not be repeated.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसने देश को यह गारंटी देने का भी आदेश दिया कि इस तरह के उल्लंघन दोबारा नहीं होंगे।।

hinglishTracks.en: Myanmar must also facilitate the return of displaced Rohingya, restore or replace lost property, help locate missing people, provide rehabilitation to survivors, and protect Rohingya from discrimination and persecution.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — म्यांमार को विस्थापित रोहिंग्या की वापसी की सुविधा देनी होगी, खोई हुई संपत्ति को बहाल करना या बदलना होगा, लापता लोगों का पता लगाने में मदद करनी होगी, बचे लोगों को पुनर्वास प्रदान करना होगा और रोहिंग्या को भेदभाव और उत्पीड़न से बचाना होगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Rehabilitation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पुनर्वास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Rehabilitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The court further ordered Myanmar to pay compensation for the harm caused to Rohingya that is not remedied through restitution.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अदालत ने म्यांमार को रोहिंग्या को हुए नुकसान के लिए मुआवजा देने का भी आदेश दिया, जिसकी भरपाई क्षतिपूर्ति से नहीं की जा सकती।।

hinglishTracks.en: Myanmar must report ‌back within two years on the measures it has taken, including proposed compensation, ​the order said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — आदेश में कहा गया है कि म्यांमार को प्रस्तावित मुआवजे सहित अपने द्वारा उठाए गए कदमों पर दो साल के भीतर रिपोर्ट देनी होगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Myanmar has maintained that operations undertaken by its security forces in northern Rakhine state during 2016–2018 ⁠were counter-terrorism actions against an insurgent group.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — म्यांमार ने कहा है कि 2016-2018 के दौरान उत्तरी राखीन राज्य में उसके सुरक्षा बलों द्वारा किए गए ऑपरेशन एक विद्रोही समूह के खिलाफ आतंकवाद विरोधी कार्रवाई थी।।

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Myanmar says it will not fully comply with ICJ genocide orders

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 10:42:15 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The ruling by ‌the ⁠ICJ, the first instance of the UN court holding a ⁠state responsible for genocide, is final but the court has very limited options to enforce it

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Myanmar's military-backed ‌President has said his administration will not comply with all ​measures ordered by the UN's top court, which last ⁠week ruled that the country's security forces had committed genocide against the Rohingya. The International Court of Justice (ICJ) found that the Myanmar military's actions against the mainly ‌Muslim Rohingya minority in 2017, including thousands of killings, the burning of hundreds of villages and widespread sexual violence, amounted ‌to genocide — and ordered a slew of measures. The ruling by ‌the ⁠ICJ, the first instance of the UN court holding a ⁠state responsible for genocide, is final but the court has very limited options to enforce it. "Myanmar would take actions appropriate for a responsible country but would not comply with requirements it considered inappropriate," he said in a meeting on ‌Wednesday, according to state media. Min Aung Hlaing did not elaborate ​on what court orders his administration considered inappropriate. The ICJ has ordered Myanmar to end ongoing breaches of the Genocide ⁠Convention and promptly investigate, prosecute and punish people reasonably suspected of involvement in the 2017 military operations. It also ordered the country to provide guarantees ‌that such violations will not be repeated. Myanmar must also facilitate the return of displaced Rohingya, restore or replace lost property, help locate missing people, provide rehabilitation to survivors, and protect Rohingya from discrimination and persecution. The court further ordered Myanmar to pay compensation for the harm caused to Rohingya that is not remedied through restitution. Myanmar must report ‌back within two years on the measures it has taken, including proposed compensation, ​the order said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Myanmar has maintained that operations undertaken by its security forces in northern Rakhine state during 2016–2018 ⁠were counter-terrorism actions against an insurgent group.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Rehabilitation (Noun)
पुनर्वास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Rehabilitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Discrimination (Adjective / Verb)
भेदभाव — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Discrimination' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

articles.title: Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnataka
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Karnataka needs a coherent policy on urban mobility

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While Karnataka has spent years disputing motorcycle owners’ right to carry paying passengers, Bengaluru — with the dubious distinction of having one of the world’s highest travel times per unit distance — struggles with inadequate public transport capacity and lacklustre intermediate options. The Supreme Court ruling on November 20 to dismiss Karnataka’s appeal was thus straightforward, allowing motorcycles to be registered as transport vehicles. The State has often called bike taxis unsafe, yet has not improved the prospects of safer options. Earlier this year, the Centre for Science and Environment estimated the number of buses in urban centres nationwide to be 70% short of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs benchmark and that 400 cities with populations between a lakh and 10 lakh altogether lacked organised bus services. In March, the BMTC reported a fleet of around 7,000 buses in Bengaluru, versus the 13,000 by 2025 envisaged by the Comprehensive Mobility Plan. Expanding the number of Metro stations also creates more demand for travel to and from stations, but the operating costs of the public transport corporation expected to serve that demand are not covered by the resulting increase in rail ridership. Overall, Karnataka has struggled to set up a consistent transport policy. An expert committee recommended against bike taxis in Bengaluru for first- and last-mile connectivity and in favour of better walking infrastructure and bicycle rentals in 2019, only for the State to launch the electric bike-taxi scheme in 2021, then rescind it in 2024 over safety concerns and drivers’ disputes. The market for short booked journeys is also dysfunctional. But while allowing bike taxis could temper autorickshaw fares, the State must investigate drivers’ operating costs, the difference between the paid and the received amounts, and prevent large platforms from exploiting the market. Finally, while the Union Road Transport Ministry has reported that 46.2% of all road deaths involved two-wheeler users, two-wheelers’ safety relative to autorickshaws and cabs, by the number and distance of journeys, is unclear. The State should require aggregators to report injuries and fatalities and investigate the consequences of drivers’ earnings being linked to the number of trips undertaken. The Union government’s 2025 Motor Vehicle Aggregator Guidelines already address passenger security, fares, and insurance while allowing States to authorise privately registered motorcycles through aggregators. Karnataka should exercise this additional power. A large national programme is required to address funding for public transport, which is necessary even when it is not immediately profitable.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka / scooters and motorbikes / public transport / court / population / urban planning / Bengaluru Metro / Electric vehicles / road accident / road transport / insurance

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — कर्नाटक को शहरी गतिशीलता पर एक सुसंगत नीति की आवश्यकता है।

hinglishTracks.en: While Karnataka has spent years disputing motorcycle owners’ right to carry paying passengers, Bengaluru — with the dubious distinction of having one of the world’s highest travel times per unit distance — struggles with inadequate public transport capacity and lacklustre intermediate options.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जबकि कर्नाटक ने मोटरसाइकिल मालिकों के यात्रियों को भुगतान करने के अधिकार पर विवाद करने में वर्षों बिताए हैं, बेंगलुरु - प्रति यूनिट दूरी के लिए दुनिया के सबसे अधिक यात्रा समय में से एक होने के संदिग्ध गौरव के साथ - अपर्याप्त सार्वजनिक परिवहन क्षमता और कमजोर मध्यवर्ती विकल्पों के साथ संघर्ष करता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Supreme Court ruling on November 20 to dismiss Karnataka’s appeal was thus straightforward, allowing motorcycles to be registered as transport vehicles.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 20 नवंबर को कर्नाटक की अपील को खारिज करने का सुप्रीम कोर्ट का फैसला सीधा था, जिससे मोटरसाइकिलों को परिवहन वाहनों के रूप में पंजीकृत करने की अनुमति मिल गई।।

hinglishTracks.en: The State has often called bike taxis unsafe, yet has not improved the prospects of safer options.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — राज्य ने अक्सर बाइक टैक्सियों को असुरक्षित कहा है, फिर भी सुरक्षित विकल्पों की संभावनाओं में सुधार नहीं किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Earlier this year, the Centre for Science and Environment estimated the number of buses in urban centres nationwide to be 70% short of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs benchmark and that 400 cities with populations between a lakh and 10 lakh altogether lacked organised bus services.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इस साल की शुरुआत में, सेंटर फॉर साइंस एंड एनवायरनमेंट ने अनुमान लगाया था कि देशभर के शहरी केंद्रों में बसों की संख्या आवास और शहरी मामलों के मंत्रालय के बेंचमार्क से 70% कम है और एक लाख से 10 लाख के बीच आबादी वाले 400 शहरों में कुल मिलाकर संगठित बस सेवाओं का अभाव है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: In March, the BMTC reported a fleet of around 7,000 buses in Bengaluru, versus the 13,000 by 2025 envisaged by the Comprehensive Mobility Plan.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मार्च में, बीएमटीसी ने बेंगलुरु में लगभग 7,000 बसों के बेड़े की सूचना दी, जबकि व्यापक गतिशीलता योजना द्वारा 2025 तक 13,000 बसों की परिकल्पना की गई थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Comprehensive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विस्तृत — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Comprehensive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Overall, Karnataka has struggled to set up a consistent transport policy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — कुल मिलाकर, कर्नाटक ने एक सुसंगत परिवहन नीति स्थापित करने के लिए संघर्ष किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: An expert committee recommended against bike taxis in Bengaluru for first- and last-mile connectivity and in favour of better walking infrastructure and bicycle rentals in 2019, only for the State to launch the electric bike-taxi scheme in 2021, then rescind it in 2024 over safety concerns and drivers’ disputes.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #6 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnataka

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 12:02:31 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Karnataka needs a coherent policy on urban mobility

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While Karnataka has spent years disputing motorcycle owners’ right to carry paying passengers, Bengaluru — with the dubious distinction of having one of the world’s highest travel times per unit distance — struggles with inadequate public transport capacity and lacklustre intermediate options. The Supreme Court ruling on November 20 to dismiss Karnataka’s appeal was thus straightforward, allowing motorcycles to be registered as transport vehicles. The State has often called bike taxis unsafe, yet has not improved the prospects of safer options. Earlier this year, the Centre for Science and Environment estimated the number of buses in urban centres nationwide to be 70% short of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs benchmark and that 400 cities with populations between a lakh and 10 lakh altogether lacked organised bus services. In March, the BMTC reported a fleet of around 7,000 buses in Bengaluru, versus the 13,000 by 2025 envisaged by the Comprehensive Mobility Plan. Expanding the number of Metro stations also creates more demand for travel to and from stations, but the operating costs of the public transport corporation expected to serve that demand are not covered by the resulting increase in rail ridership. Overall, Karnataka has struggled to set up a consistent transport policy. An expert committee recommended against bike taxis in Bengaluru for first- and last-mile connectivity and in favour of better walking infrastructure and bicycle rentals in 2019, only for the State to launch the electric bike-taxi scheme in 2021, then rescind it in 2024 over safety concerns and drivers’ disputes. The market for short booked journeys is also dysfunctional. But while allowing bike taxis could temper autorickshaw fares, the State must investigate drivers’ operating costs, the difference between the paid and the received amounts, and prevent large platforms from exploiting the market. Finally, while the Union Road Transport Ministry has reported that 46.2% of all road deaths involved two-wheeler users, two-wheelers’ safety relative to autorickshaws and cabs, by the number and distance of journeys, is unclear. The State should require aggregators to report injuries and fatalities and investigate the consequences of drivers’ earnings being linked to the number of trips undertaken. The Union government’s 2025 Motor Vehicle Aggregator Guidelines already address passenger security, fares, and insurance while allowing States to authorise privately registered motorcycles through aggregators. Karnataka should exercise this additional power. A large national programme is required to address funding for public transport, which is necessary even when it is not immediately profitable.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka / scooters and motorbikes / public transport / court / population / urban planning / Bengaluru Metro / Electric vehicles / road accident / road transport / insurance

Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Comprehensive (Adjective)
विस्तृत — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Comprehensive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Dysfunctional (Adjective)
बेकार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Dysfunctional' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Connectivity (Noun)
कनेक्टिविटी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Connectivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnataka", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Karnataka needs a coherent policy on urban mobility.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnataka' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnata' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnata' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Karnataka needs a coherent policy on urban mobility." (Hinglish Arth: कर्नाटक को शहरी गतिशीलता पर एक सुसंगत नीति की आवश्यकता है)

B. Karnataka / scooters and motorbikes / public transport / court / population / urban planning / Bengaluru Metro / Electric vehicles / road accident /...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: SHRC directs NHAI, KSEB to complete installation of lights on Container Road
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Kerala State Human Rights Commission (SHRC) has directed the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) to complete the installation of streetlights on the 17-Km-long, accident-prone Container Road.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Subsequently, the agency’s project director must report the matter to the Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB). The KSEB must take steps to provide power connection within two weeks, the Commission directed the agency’s executive engineer.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Commission’s directive came on a complaint filed before it by C.J. Johnson, an engineer, stating that many national highway corridors owned and maintained by the NHAI did not have streetlights.
